ADSB_CALLSIGN_1.longDesc:
Sets first 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " ". Example "PX4 " -> 1347957792
For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

ADSB_CALLSIGN_2.longDesc:
Sets second 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " " only. Example "TEST" -> 1413829460
For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

ADSB_EMIT_TYPE.longDesc: Configure the emitter type of the vehicle.

ADSB_ICAO_ID.longDesc: Defines the ICAO ID of the vehicle

ADSB_ICAO_ID_2.longDesc: Optional second ownship ICAO ID used to filter self-detections. Use -1 to disable.

ADSB_ICAO_SPECL.longDesc: This vehicle is always tracked. Use 0 to disable.

ADSB_LEN_WIDTH.longDesc: Report the length and width of the vehicle in meters. In most cases, use '1' for the smallest vehicle size.

ADSB_LIST_MAX.longDesc: Change number of targets to track

ADSB_MAX_SPEED.longDesc: Informs ADSB vehicles of this vehicle's max speed capability

ADSB_SQUAWK.longDesc: This parameter defines the squawk code. Value should be between 0000 and 7777.

ASPD_BETA_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for sideslip angle fusion
ASPD_BETA_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_BETA_NOISE.longDesc: Sideslip measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_DO_CHECKS.longDesc:
Controls which checks are run to check airspeed data for validity. Only applied if ASPD_PRIMARY > 0.
Note: The missing data check (bit 0) is implicitly always enabled when ASPD_DO_CHECKS > 0, even if bit 0 is not explicitly set.
bitmask: Only data missing check (triggers if more than 1s no data)
Data stuck (triggers if data is exactly constant for 2s in FW mode)
Load factor check (triggers if measurement is below stall speed)
First principle check (airspeed change vs. throttle and pitch)

values: Fallback only to other airspeed sensors
Fallback to thrust based airspeed estimation

ASPD_FALLBACK_GW.shortDesc: Enable fallback to sensor-less airspeed estimation
ASPD_FALLBACK_GW.longDesc: If set to true and airspeed checks are enabled, it will use a sensor-less airspeed estimation based on groundspeed minus windspeed if no other airspeed sensor available to fall back to.

ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.shortDesc: First principle airspeed check time window
ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.longDesc:
Window for comparing airspeed change to throttle and pitch change.
Triggers when the airspeed change within this window is negative while throttle increases
and the vehicle pitches down.
Is meant to catch degrading airspeed blockages as can happen when flying through icing conditions.
Relies on  FW_THR_TRIM being set accurately.

ASPD_FS_INNOV.longDesc:
This specifies the minimum airspeed innovation required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive,
smaller values make it more sensitive. Large innovations indicate an inconsistency between predicted (groundspeed - windspeeed)
and measured airspeed.
The time required to detect a fault when the threshold is exceeded depends on the size of the exceedance and is controlled by the ASPD_FS_INTEG parameter.

ASPD_FS_INTEG.longDesc:
This sets the time integral of airspeed innovation exceedance above ASPD_FS_INNOV required to trigger a failsafe.
Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller positive values make it more sensitive.

ASPD_FS_T_START.longDesc:
Delay before switching back to using airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is good.
Set to a negative value to disable the re-enabling in flight.

ASPD_FS_T_STOP.longDesc: Delay before stopping use of airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is bad.

ASPD_PRIMARY.shortDesc: Index or primary airspeed measurement source

ASPD_SCALE.shortDesc: Airspeed scale (scale from IAS to CAS)
ASPD_SCALE.longDesc: Scale can either be entered manually, or estimated in-flight by setting ASPD_SCALE_EST to 1.

ASPD_SCALE_1.longDesc: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the first airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_2.longDesc: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the second airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_3.longDesc: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the third airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_APPLY.shortDesc: Controls when to apply the new estimated airspeed scale(s)
values: Do not automatically apply the estimated scale
Apply the estimated scale after disarm
Apply the estimated scale in air

ASPD_SCALE_EST.longDesc: Turns the automatic airspeed scale (scale from IAS to CAS) on or off. It is recommended to fly level altitude while performing the estimation. Set to 1 to start estimation (best when already flying). Set to 0 to end scale estimation. The estimated scale is then saved using the ASPD_SCALE parameter.

ASPD_SCALE_NSD.shortDesc: Wind estimator true airspeed scale process noise spectral density
ASPD_SCALE_NSD.longDesc:
Airspeed scale process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.
When unaided, the scale uncertainty (1-sigma, unitless) increases by this amount every second.

ASPD_SC_P_NOISE.shortDesc: Airspeed Selector: Wind estimator true airspeed scale process noise
ASPD_SC_P_NOISE.longDesc: Airspeed scale process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_TAS_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for true airspeed fusion
ASPD_TAS_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_TAS_NOISE.shortDesc: Wind estimator true airspeed measurement noise
ASPD_TAS_NOISE.longDesc: True airspeed measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_WERR_THR.shortDesc: Horizontal wind uncertainty threshold for valid ground-minus-wind
ASPD_WERR_THR.longDesc:
The airspeed alternative derived from groundspeed and heading will be declared valid
as soon and as long the horizontal wind uncertainty is below this value.

ASPD_WIND_NSD.shortDesc: Wind estimator wind process noise spectral density
ASPD_WIND_NSD.longDesc:
Wind process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.
When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

ASPD_W_P_NOISE.shortDesc: Airspeed Selector: Wind estimator wind process noise
ASPD_W_P_NOISE.longDesc: Wind process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ATT_ACC_COMP.shortDesc: Acceleration compensation based on GPS velocity

ATT_EN.longDesc: Enable standalone quaternion based attitude estimator.

ATT_EXT_HDG_M.shortDesc: External heading usage mode (from Motion capture/Vision)
ATT_EXT_HDG_M.longDesc:
Set to 1 to use heading estimate from vision.
Set to 2 to use heading from motion capture.

ATT_MAG_DECL.longDesc:
This parameter is not used in normal operation,
as the declination is looked up based on the
GPS coordinates of the vehicle.

ATT_W_MAG.longDesc: Set to 0 to avoid using the magnetometer.

AVC_X_D.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity D gain
AVC_X_D.longDesc: Body X axis angular velocity differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

AVC_X_FF.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity feedforward gain

AVC_X_I.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity I gain
AVC_X_I.longDesc: Body X axis angular velocity integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

AVC_X_I_LIM.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity integrator limit
AVC_X_I_LIM.longDesc: Body X axis angular velocity integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large roll moment trim changes.

AVC_X_K.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity controller gain
AVC_X_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = AVC_X_K * (AVC_X_P * error + AVC_X_I * error_integral + AVC_X_D * error_derivative) Set AVC_X_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set AVC_X_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

AVC_X_P.shortDesc: Body X axis angular velocity P gain
AVC_X_P.longDesc: Body X axis angular velocity proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

AVC_Y_D.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity D gain
AVC_Y_D.longDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

AVC_Y_FF.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity feedforward

AVC_Y_I.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity I gain
AVC_Y_I.longDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

AVC_Y_I_LIM.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity integrator limit
AVC_Y_I_LIM.longDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

AVC_Y_K.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity controller gain
AVC_Y_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = AVC_Y_K * (AVC_Y_P * error + AVC_Y_I * error_integral + AVC_Y_D * error_derivative) Set AVC_Y_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set AVC_Y_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

AVC_Y_P.shortDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity P gain
AVC_Y_P.longDesc: Body Y axis angular velocity proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

AVC_Z_D.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity D gain
AVC_Z_D.longDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

AVC_Z_FF.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity feedforward

AVC_Z_I.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity I gain
AVC_Z_I.longDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

AVC_Z_I_LIM.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity integrator limit
AVC_Z_I_LIM.longDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

AVC_Z_K.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity controller gain
AVC_Z_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = AVC_Z_K * (AVC_Z_P * error + AVC_Z_I * error_integral + AVC_Z_D * error_derivative) Set AVC_Z_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set AVC_Z_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

AVC_Z_P.shortDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity P gain
AVC_Z_P.longDesc: Body Z axis angular velocity proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

BAT1_A_PER_V.longDesc: The voltage seen by the ADC multiplied by this factor will determine the battery current. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_CAPACITY.longDesc: Defines the capacity of battery 1 in mAh.

BAT1_I_CHANNEL.longDesc: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor current of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_I_OVERWRITE.longDesc: While disarmed, replaces the measured current with this value in amps, for ESCs that measure current inaccurately at no load. Set to 0 or less to disable.

BAT1_N_CELLS.longDesc: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT1_R_INTERNAL.shortDesc: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 1
BAT1_R_INTERNAL.longDesc: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT1_SOURCE.longDesc:
This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module'
means that measurements are expected to come from a power module. If the value is set to
'External' then the system expects to receive mavlink battery status messages.
If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message.
This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current.

BAT1_V_CHANNEL.longDesc: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor voltage of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_V_CHARGED.longDesc:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full.
For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

BAT1_V_DIV.longDesc: This is the divider from battery 1 voltage to ADC voltage. If using e.g. Mauch power modules the value from the datasheet can be applied straight here. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_V_EMPTY.longDesc:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty.
The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical
lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before
it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP.shortDesc: Voltage drop per cell on full throttle
BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP.longDesc: This implicitely defines the internal resistance to maximum current ratio for battery 1 and assumes linearity. A good value to use is the difference between the 5C and 20-25C load. Not used if BAT1_R_INTERNAL is set.

BAT2_A_PER_V.longDesc: The voltage seen by the ADC multiplied by this factor will determine the battery current. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_CAPACITY.longDesc: Defines the capacity of battery 2 in mAh.

BAT2_I_CHANNEL.longDesc: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor current of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_I_OVERWRITE.longDesc: While disarmed, replaces the measured current with this value in amps, for ESCs that measure current inaccurately at no load. Set to 0 or less to disable.

BAT2_N_CELLS.longDesc: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT2_R_INTERNAL.shortDesc: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 2
BAT2_R_INTERNAL.longDesc: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT_ADC_CHANNEL.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_ADC_CHANNEL

BAT_AVRG_CURRENT.longDesc:
This value is used to initialize the in-flight average current estimation,
which in turn is used for estimating remaining flight time and RTL triggering.

BAT_A_PER_V.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_A_PER_V

BAT_CAPACITY.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_CAPACITY instead

BAT_CRIT_THR.longDesc:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as critically low.
This has to be lower than the low threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger RTL.

BAT_C_MULT.shortDesc: Capacity/current multiplier for high-current capable SMBUS battery

BAT_EMERGEN_THR.longDesc:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as dangerously low.
This has to be lower than the critical threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger landing.

BAT_LOW_THR.longDesc:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as low.
This has to be higher than the critical threshold.

BAT_N_CELLS.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_N_CELLS instead
BAT_N_CELLS.longDesc: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT_R_INTERNAL.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_R_INTERNAL instead
BAT_R_INTERNAL.longDesc: If non-negative, then this will be used in place of BAT_V_LOAD_DROP for all calculations.

BAT_SOURCE.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_SOURCE instead
BAT_SOURCE.longDesc: Battery monitoring source. This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module' means that measurements are expected to come from a power module. If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive mavlink battery status messages.

BAT_V_CHARGED.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_V_CHARGED instead
BAT_V_CHARGED.longDesc: Defines the voltage where a single cell of battery 1 is considered full under a mild load. This will never be the nominal voltage of 4.2V

BAT_V_DIV.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_V_DIV

BAT_V_EMPTY.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_V_EMPTY instead
BAT_V_EMPTY.longDesc: Defines the voltage where a single cell of battery 1 is considered empty. The voltage should be chosen before the steep dropoff to 2.8V. A typical lithium battery can only be discharged down to 10% before it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT_V_LOAD_DROP.shortDesc: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_V_LOAD_DROP instead
BAT_V_LOAD_DROP.longDesc: This implicitely defines the internal resistance to maximum current ratio for battery 1 and assumes linearity. A good value to use is the difference between the 5C and 20-25C load. Not used if BAT_R_INTERNAL is set.

BAT_V_OFFS_CURR.shortDesc: Offset in volt as seen by the ADC input of the current sensor
BAT_V_OFFS_CURR.longDesc: This offset will be subtracted before calculating the battery current based on the voltage.

CA_AIR_SCALE_EN.longDesc: This compensates for the variation of flap effectiveness with airspeed.

CA_BAT_SCALE_EN.longDesc: This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery, it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

This is used to specify how to handle motor failures

CA_HELI_PITCH_C0.longDesc:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 0 for a given thrust setpoint.
Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C1.longDesc:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 1 for a given thrust setpoint.
Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C2.longDesc:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 2 for a given thrust setpoint.
Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C3.longDesc:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 3 for a given thrust setpoint.
Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C4.longDesc:
Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 4 for a given thrust setpoint.
Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_RPM_I.longDesc: Same definition as the proportional gain but for integral.

CA_HELI_RPM_P.longDesc:
Ratio between rpm error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.
motor_command = throttle_curve + CA_HELI_RPM_P * (rpm_setpoint - rpm_measurement) / 1000

CA_HELI_RPM_SP.longDesc: Requires rpm feedback for the controller.

CA_HELI_THR_C0.longDesc: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 0.

CA_HELI_THR_C1.longDesc: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 1.

CA_HELI_THR_C2.longDesc: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 2.

CA_HELI_THR_C3.longDesc: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 3.

CA_HELI_THR_C4.longDesc: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 4.

CA_HELI_YAW_CCW.longDesc:
Default configuration is for a clockwise turning main rotor and
positive thrust of the tail rotor is expected to rotate the vehicle clockwise.
Set this parameter to true if the tail rotor provides thrust in counter-clockwise direction
which is mostly the case when the main rotor turns counter-clockwise.

CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O.shortDesc: Offset for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O.longDesc:
This allows to specify which collective pitch command results in the least amount of rotor drag.
This is used to increase the accuracy of the yaw drag torque compensation based on collective pitch
by aligning the lowest rotor drag with zero compensation.
For symmetric profile blades this is the command that results in exactly 0° collective blade angle.
For lift profile blades this is typically a command resulting in slightly negative collective blade angle.
tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S.shortDesc: Scale for yaw compensation based on collective pitch
CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S.longDesc:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the collective pitch command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.
tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S.shortDesc: Scale for yaw compensation based on throttle
CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S.longDesc:
This allows to add a proportional factor of the throttle command to the yaw command.
A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction.
tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S * throttle

CA_ICE_PERIOD.longDesc:
Ice shedding prevents ice buildup in VTOL aircraft motors by periodically spinning inactive rotors.
When enabled (period > 0), every cycle lasts for the defined period and includes a 2-second spin at 0.01 motor output.
If period <= 0, the feature is disabled.

CA_MAX_SVO_THROW.shortDesc: Throw angle of swashplate servo at maximum commands for linearization
CA_MAX_SVO_THROW.longDesc:
Used to linearize mechanical output of swashplate servos to avoid axis coupling and binding with 4 servo redundancy.
This requires a symmetric setup where the servo horn is exactly centered with a 0 command.
Setting to zero disables feature.

CBRK_AIRSPD_CHK.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 162128 will disable the check for an airspeed sensor. The sensor driver will not be started and it cannot be calibrated. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_BUZZER.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 782097 will disable the buzzer audio notification.
Setting this parameter to 782090 will disable the startup tune, while keeping
all others enabled.

CBRK_ENGINEFAIL.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for engine failure detection
CBRK_ENGINEFAIL.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 284953 will disable the engine failure detection. If the aircraft is in engine failure mode the engine failure flag will be set to healthy WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_FLIGHTTERM.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 121212 will disable the flight termination action if triggered
by the FailureDetector logic or if FMU is lost.
This circuit breaker does not affect the RC loss, data link loss, geofence,
and takeoff failure detection safety logic.

CBRK_IO_SAFETY.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 22027 will disable IO safety.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_RATE_CTRL.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for rate controller output
CBRK_RATE_CTRL.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 140253 will disable the rate controller uORB publication. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for power supply check
CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 894281 will disable the power valid
checks in the commander.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_UAVCAN_FW.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for UAVCAN firmware update arming check
CBRK_UAVCAN_FW.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 5318008 will allow arming even when a UAVCAN
node firmware update is pending or a node went offline mid-update.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_USB_CHK.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for USB link check
CBRK_USB_CHK.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 197848 will disable the USB connected
checks in the commander, setting it to 0 keeps them enabled (recommended).
We are generally recommending to not fly with the USB link
connected and production vehicles should set this parameter to
zero to prevent users from flying USB powered. However, for R&D purposes
it has proven over the years to work just fine.

CBRK_VELPOSERR.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for position error check
CBRK_VELPOSERR.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 201607 will disable the position and velocity accuracy checks in the commander. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_VTOLARMING.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for arming in fixed-wing mode check
CBRK_VTOLARMING.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 159753 will enable arming in fixed-wing
mode for VTOLs.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.shortDesc: Set the actuator failure failsafe mode
COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.longDesc:
Note: actuator failure needs to be enabled and configured via FD_ACT_*
parameters.

COM_ARMABLE.longDesc: Set 0 to prevent accidental use of the vehicle e.g. for safety or maintenance reasons.

COM_ARM_ARSP_EN.shortDesc: Enable preflight check for maximal allowed airspeed when arming
COM_ARM_ARSP_EN.longDesc: Deny arming if the current airspeed measurement is greater than half the cruise airspeed (FW_AIRSPD_TRIM). Excessive airspeed measurements on ground are either caused by wind or bad airspeed calibration.

COM_ARM_AUTH_ID.longDesc: Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_MET.longDesc:
Methods:
- one arm: request authorization and arm when authorization is received
- two step arm: 1st arm command request an authorization and
2nd arm command arm the drone if authorized
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.longDesc: By default off. The default allows to arm the vehicle without a arm authorization.

COM_ARM_AUTH_TO.longDesc:
Timeout for authorizer answer.
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_BAT_MIN.longDesc:
Threshold for battery percentage below arming is prohibited.
A negative value means BAT_CRIT_THR is the threshold.

COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.shortDesc: Enable checks on ESCs that report telemetry
COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.longDesc:
If this parameter is set, the system will check ESC's online status and failures.
This param is specific for ESCs reporting status. It shall be used only if ESCs support telemetry.

COM_ARM_EKF_HGT.shortDesc: Maximum EKF height innovation test ratio that will allow arming

COM_ARM_EKF_POS.shortDesc: Maximum EKF position innovation test ratio that will allow arming

COM_ARM_EKF_VEL.shortDesc: Maximum EKF velocity innovation test ratio that will allow arming

COM_ARM_EKF_YAW.shortDesc: Maximum EKF yaw innovation test ratio that will allow arming

COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.shortDesc: Enable FMU SD card hardfault detection check
COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.longDesc:
This check detects if there are hardfault files present on the
SD card. If so, and the parameter is enabled, arming is prevented.

COM_ARM_IMU_ACC.shortDesc: Maximum accelerometer inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_IMU_GYR.shortDesc: Maximum rate gyro inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_MAG_ANG.shortDesc: Maximum magnetic field inconsistency between units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_MAG_STR.longDesc:
Check if the estimator detects a strong magnetic
disturbance (check enabled by EKF2_MAG_CHECK)

COM_ARM_MIS_REQ.longDesc: The default allows to arm the vehicle without a valid mission.

COM_ARM_ODID.shortDesc: Enable Drone ID system detection and health check
COM_ARM_ODID.longDesc:
This check detects if the Open Drone ID system is missing.
Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only or deny arming.
values: Enforce Open Drone ID system presence

COM_ARM_ON_BOOT.longDesc:
When enabled, the vehicle arms automatically once all preflight checks pass after boot.
The vehicle will not re-arm after a manual disarm.
Has no effect if COM_ARMABLE is 0.

COM_ARM_SDCARD.shortDesc: Enable FMU SD card detection check
COM_ARM_SDCARD.longDesc:
This check detects if the FMU SD card is missing.
Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only or deny arming.

COM_ARM_SWISBTN.shortDesc: Arm switch is a momentary button
COM_ARM_SWISBTN.longDesc:
0: Arming/disarming triggers on switch transition.
1: Arming/disarming triggers when holding the momentary button down
for COM_RC_ARM_HYST like the stick gesture.

COM_ARM_TRAFF.shortDesc: Enable Traffic Avoidance system detection check
COM_ARM_TRAFF.longDesc:
This check detects if a traffic avoidance system (ADSB/FLARM transponder)
is missing. Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only, or deny arming.

COM_ARM_WO_GPS.longDesc: Measures taken when a check defined by EKF2_GPS_CHECK is failing.

COM_CC_TEMP_WARN.longDesc:
Arming is not prevented as the temperature typically drops in flight.

Set to -1 to disable.

COM_CPU_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum allowed CPU load to still arm
COM_CPU_MAX.longDesc:
The check fails if the CPU load is above this threshold for 2s.
A negative value disables the check.

COM_DISARM_LAND.shortDesc: Time-out for auto disarm after landing
COM_DISARM_LAND.longDesc:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time-out period in seconds after which the vehicle will be
automatically disarmed in case a landing situation has been detected during this period.
A zero or negative value means that automatic disarming triggered by landing detection is disabled.

COM_DISARM_MAN.shortDesc: Allow disarming via switch/stick/button on multicopters in manual thrust modes
COM_DISARM_MAN.longDesc:
0: Disallow disarming when not landed
1: Allow disarming in multicopter flight in modes where
the thrust is directly controlled by thr throttle stick
e.g. Stabilized, Acro

COM_DISARM_PRFLT.shortDesc: Time-out for auto disarm if not taking off
COM_DISARM_PRFLT.longDesc:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time in seconds, within which the
vehicle is expected to take off after arming. In case the vehicle didn't takeoff
within the timeout it disarms again.
A negative value disables autmoatic disarming triggered by a pre-takeoff timeout.

COM_DLL_EXCEPT.longDesc: Specify modes in which datalink loss is ignored and the failsafe action not triggered.

COM_DL_LOSS_T.longDesc: After this amount of seconds without datalink, the GCS connection lost mode triggers

COM_EF_C2T.longDesc: Engine failure triggers only below this current value

COM_EF_THROT.longDesc: Engine failure triggers only above this throttle value

COM_EF_TIME.longDesc: Engine failure triggers only if the throttle threshold and the current to throttle threshold are violated for this time

COM_FAIL_ACT_T.shortDesc: Delay between failsafe condition triggered and failsafe reaction
COM_FAIL_ACT_T.longDesc:
Before entering failsafe (RTL, Land, Hold), wait COM_FAIL_ACT_T seconds in Hold mode
for the user to realize.
During that time the user can switch modes, but cannot take over control via the stick override feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE).
Afterwards the configured failsafe action is triggered and the user may use stick override.
A zero value disables the delay.

COM_FLIGHT_UUID.longDesc:
This number is incremented automatically after every flight on
disarming in order to remember the next flight UUID.
The first flight is 0.

COM_FLTMODE1.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE2.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE3.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE4.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE5.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE6.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE_BOOT.longDesc:
Flight mode set on boot and after a power cycle, before any RC input or
mode command is received.

COM_FLTT_LOW_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes when the remaining flight time is below
the estimated time it takes to reach the RTL destination.

COM_FLT_PROFILE.longDesc:
Describes the intended use of the vehicle.
Can be used by ground control software or log post processing.
This param does not influence the behavior within the firmware. This means for example the control logic is independent of the setting of this param (but depends on other params).

COM_FLT_TIME_MAX.longDesc:
The vehicle aborts the current operation and returns to launch when
the time since takeoff is above this value. It is not possible to resume the
mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.
Starting from 90% of the maximum flight time, a warning message will be sent
every 1 minute with the remaining time until automatic RTL.
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_FORCE_SAFETY.longDesc: Force safety when the vehicle disarms

COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes when a GNSS failure is detected during flight.
Triggers when the active GNSS count drops below SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS (disabled
when SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=0), or when two receivers report positions inconsistent
with their reported accuracy and SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=2 (otherwise warning only).
The reported accuracy of each receiver is floored with EKF2_GPS_P_NOISE.
Any value above Warning also blocks arming.

COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.shortDesc: High Latency Datalink loss time threshold
COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.longDesc: After this amount of seconds without datalink the data link lost mode triggers

COM_HLDL_REG_T.shortDesc: High Latency Datalink regain time threshold
COM_HLDL_REG_T.longDesc:
After a data link loss: after this number of seconds with a healthy datalink the 'datalink loss'
flag is set back to false

COM_HOME_EN.longDesc:
Set home position automatically if possible.
During missions, the latitude/longitude of the home position is locked and will not reset during intermediate landings.
It will only update once the mission is complete or landed outside of a mission.
However, the altitude is still being adjusted to correct for GNSS vertical drift in the first 2 minutes after takeoff.

COM_HOME_H_T.longDesc: The home position will be set if the estimated positioning accuracy is below the threshold.

COM_HOME_IN_AIR.shortDesc: Allows setting the home position after takeoff
COM_HOME_IN_AIR.longDesc:
If set to true, the autopilot is allowed to set its home position after takeoff
The true home position is back-computed if a local position is estimate if available.
If no local position is available, home is set to the current position.

COM_HOME_V_T.longDesc: The home position will be set if the estimated positioning accuracy is below the threshold.

COM_IMB_PROP_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes when an imbalanced propeller is detected by the failure detector.
See also FD_IMB_PROP_THR to set the failure threshold.

COM_KILL_DISARM.shortDesc: Timeout value for disarming when kill switch is engaged
COM_KILL_DISARM.longDesc: Use RC_MAP_KILL_SW to map a kill switch.

COM_LKDOWN_TKO.shortDesc: Timeout for detecting a failure after takeoff
COM_LKDOWN_TKO.longDesc:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the timeframe in seconds within failure detector is allowed to disarm the vehicle
if attitude exceeds the limits defined in FD_FAIL_P and FD_FAIL_R.
The check is not executed for flight modes that do support acrobatic maneuvers, e.g: Acro (MC/FW) and Manual (FW).
A zero or negative value means that the check is disabled.

COM_LOW_BAT_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes at critical battery. See also BAT_CRIT_THR and BAT_EMERGEN_THR
for definition of battery states.
values: Return at critical level, land at emergency level

COM_MODE0_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE1_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE2_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE3_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE4_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE5_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE6_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE7_HASH.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.shortDesc: Allow external mode registration while armed
COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.longDesc: By default disabled for safety reasons

COM_MOT_TEST_EN.longDesc:
If set, enables the actuator test interface via MAVLink (ACTUATOR_TEST), that
allows spinning the motors and moving the servos for testing purposes.

COM_OBC_LOSS_T.shortDesc: Time-out to wait when onboard computer connection is lost before warning about loss connection

COM_OBL_ACT.longDesc: The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

COM_OBL_RC_ACT.longDesc:
The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

COM_OF_LOSS_T.shortDesc: Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action

COM_PARACHUTE.shortDesc: Expect and require a healthy MAVLink parachute system

COM_POSCTL_NAVL.longDesc: This sets the flight mode that will be used if navigation accuracy is no longer adequate for position control in manual Position mode.

COM_POS_FS_ACT.longDesc:
Final fallback failsafe action for loss of horizontal position in autonomous modes:
- Descend (potential for horizontal drift on landing)
- Flight termination (allows parachute landing)

COM_POS_FS_DELAY.shortDesc: Loss of position failsafe activation delay
COM_POS_FS_DELAY.longDesc: This sets number of seconds that the position checks need to be failed before the failsafe will activate. The default value has been optimised for rotary wing applications. For fixed wing applications, a larger value between 5 and 10 should be used.

COM_POS_FS_EPH.shortDesc: Horizontal position error threshold for hovering systems
COM_POS_FS_EPH.longDesc:
This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).
Only used for multicopters and VTOLs in hover mode.
Independent from estimator positioning data timeout threshold (see EKF2_NOAID_TOUT).
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POS_FS_EPV.longDesc: This is the vertical position error (EPV) threshold that will trigger a failsafe. The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.

COM_POS_FS_GAIN.shortDesc: Loss of position probation gain factor
COM_POS_FS_GAIN.longDesc: This sets the rate that the loss of position probation time grows when position checks are failing. The default value has been optimised for rotary wing applications. For fixed wing applications a value of 0 should be used.

COM_POS_FS_PROB.shortDesc: Loss of position probation delay at takeoff
COM_POS_FS_PROB.longDesc: The probation delay is the number of seconds that the EKF innovation checks need to pass for the position to be declared good after it has been declared bad. The probation delay will be reset to this parameter value when takeoff is detected. After takeoff, if position checks are passing, the probation delay will reduce by one second for every lapsed second of valid position down to a minimum of 1 second. If position checks are failing, the probation delay will increase by COM_POS_FS_GAIN seconds for every lapsed second up to a maximum of 100 seconds. The default value has been optimised for rotary wing applications. For fixed wing applications, a value of 1 should be used.

COM_POS_LOW_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold.
See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold.
The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode,
otherwise it is only a warning.

COM_POS_LOW_EPH.longDesc:
This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold.
Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT),
and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH).
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POWER_COUNT.shortDesc: Required number of redundant power modules
COM_POWER_COUNT.longDesc:
This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected.
Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

COM_PREARM_MODE.longDesc:
Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed
in which non-throttling actuators are active.

COM_RAM_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks
COM_RAM_MAX.longDesc:
The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold.
A negative value disables the check.

COM_RCL_ACT_T.shortDesc: Delay between RC loss and configured reaction
COM_RCL_ACT_T.longDesc: RC signal not updated -> still use data for COM_RC_LOSS_T seconds Consider RC signal lost -> wait COM_RCL_ACT_T seconds on the spot waiting to regain signal React with failsafe action NAV_RCL_ACT A zero value disables the delay.

COM_RCL_EXCEPT.longDesc:
Specify modes where manual control loss is ignored and no failsafe is triggered.
External modes requiring stick input will still failsafe.

COM_RC_ARM_HYST.shortDesc: Manual control input arm/disarm command duration
COM_RC_ARM_HYST.longDesc: The default value of 1000 requires the stick to be held in the arm or disarm position for 1 second.

COM_RC_IN_MODE.longDesc:
Selects stick input selection behavior:
either a traditional remote control receiver (RC) or a MAVLink joystick (MANUAL_CONTROL message)
Priority sources are immediately switched to whenever they get valid.
0 RC only. Requires valid RC calibration.
1 MAVLink only. RC and related checks are disabled.
2 Switches only if current source becomes invalid.
3 Locks to the first valid source until reboot.
4 Ignores all sources.
5 RC priority, then MAVLink (lower instance before higher)
6 MAVLink priority (lower instance before higher), then RC
7 RC priority, then MAVLink (higher instance before lower)
8 MAVLink priority (higher instance before lower), then RC

COM_RC_LOSS_T.longDesc:
The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost.
This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.
Ensure the value is not set lower than the update interval of the RC or Joystick.

COM_RC_OVERRIDE.longDesc:
When enabled, moving the sticks more than COM_RC_STICK_OV
immediately gives control back to the pilot by switching to Position mode and
if position is unavailable Altitude mode.
Note: Only has an effect on multicopters, and VTOLs in multicopter mode.
bitmask: Enable override during auto modes (except for in critical battery reaction)

COM_RC_STICK_OV.longDesc:
If COM_RC_OVERRIDE is enabled and the joystick input is moved more than this threshold
the autopilot the pilot takes over control.

COM_REARM_GRACE.longDesc: Re-arming grace allows to rearm the drone with manual command without running prearmcheck during 5 s after disarming.

COM_SAFETY_MODE.longDesc:
Condition to turn safety off. Vehicle arming is prevented for as long as safety is on.

0: Always off.
1: Safety can be turned off either by pressing a physical safety switch, or by sending a MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SAFETY_SWITCH_STATE command.
2: Safety can only be turned off by pressing a physical safety switch. MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SAFETY_SWITCH_STATE commands are rejected.
3: Safety can only be turned off by sending a MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SAFETY_SWITCH_STATE command. Any physical switch is ignored.
values: Safety switch (physical or virtual via MAVLink)

COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.shortDesc: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation
COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.longDesc:
The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds.
Goal:
- Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster
- Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks
e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.shortDesc: Action after TAKEOFF has been accepted
COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.longDesc: The mode transition after TAKEOFF has completed successfully.

COM_THROW_EN.longDesc: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

COM_THROW_SPEED.shortDesc: Minimum speed for the throw start
COM_THROW_SPEED.longDesc:
When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed
is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does
not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw.
Set to 0 to disable.

COM_TRAFF_AVOID.shortDesc: Traffic avoidance system requirement and failsafe
COM_TRAFF_AVOID.longDesc:
Warn about, and optionally require, a traffic avoidance system (ADS-B/FLARM
transponder, detected via MAVLink heartbeats with a 3 second timeout), and
trigger a failsafe action when it is missing or lost in flight.

COM_VEL_FS_EVH.longDesc:
This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.
If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

COM_WIND_MAX.longDesc:
Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered.
Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.longDesc:
Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected.
See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold.
If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than
RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

COM_WIND_WARN.longDesc:
A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value.
Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute).
Set to -1 to disable.

CP_DELAY.shortDesc: Average delay of the range sensor message plus the tracking delay of the position controller in seconds

CP_DIST.shortDesc: Minimum distance the vehicle should keep to all obstacles
CP_DIST.longDesc: Only used in Position mode. Collision avoidance is disabled by setting this parameter to a negative value

CP_GO_NO_DATA.shortDesc: Boolean to allow moving into directions where there is no sensor data (outside FOV)

CP_GUIDE_ANG.shortDesc: Angle left/right from the commanded setpoint by which the collision prevention algorithm can choose to change the setpoint direction

DAA_DFLT_VEL.shortDesc: Default vertical speed of other aircraft
DAA_DFLT_VEL.longDesc: Used when DAA_EN_DFLT_VEL is enabled. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_EN_DFLT_VEL.shortDesc: Ignore reported vertical speed of other aircraft
DAA_EN_DFLT_VEL.longDesc: Use DAA_DFLT_VEL instead of reported traffic vertical speed. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_CRIT_ACT.longDesc:
Action requested when the critical conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_CRIT_HGT.longDesc: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_CRIT_RAD.longDesc: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_HIGH_ACT.longDesc:
Action requested when the high conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_HIGH_HGT.longDesc: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_HIGH_RAD.longDesc: Per-aircraft half-zone. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_LOW_ACT.longDesc:
Action requested when the low conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_LOW_TIME.longDesc: Expands well-clear bounds by aircraft speed times this value. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_MED_ACT.longDesc:
Action requested when the medium conflict level is reached.
Runtime changes apply on later conflict level transitions.
Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_LVL_MED_TIME.longDesc: Expands NMAC bounds by aircraft speed times this value. Specific to the F3442 DAA standard.

DAA_NOTIF_STATE.longDesc: Time between notifications for the most urgent conflict. Set to 0 to disable the periodic status notification.

DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H.longDesc: When the actuator_output is between DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L and DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H, motor will not spin. This value is with respect to the mixer_module range (0-1999), not the DSHOT values.

DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L.longDesc: When the actuator_output is between DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L and DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H, motor will not spin. This value is with respect to the mixer_module range (0-1999), not the DSHOT values.

DSHOT_3D_ENABLE.shortDesc: Allows for 3d mode when using DShot and suitable mixer
DSHOT_3D_ENABLE.longDesc: WARNING: ESC must be configured for 3D mode, and DSHOT_MIN set to 0. This splits the throttle ranges in two. Direction 1) 48 is the slowest, 1047 is the fastest. Direction 2) 1049 is the slowest, 2047 is the fastest. When mixer outputs 1000 or value inside DSHOT 3D deadband, DShot 0 is sent.

DSHOT_CONFIG.longDesc: This enables/disables DShot. The different modes define different speeds, for example DShot150 = 150kb/s. Not all ESCs support all modes. Note: this enables DShot on the FMU outputs. For boards with an IO it is the AUX outputs.

DSHOT_MIN.longDesc: Minimum Output Value for DShot in percent. The value depends on the ESC. Make sure to set this high enough so that the motors are always spinning while armed.

DSHOT_TEL_CFG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run DShot Driver.

EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.shortDesc: Maximum IMU accel magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.longDesc: If the magnitude of the IMU accelerometer vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of high manoeuvre accelerations and IMU nonlinerity and scale factor errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.shortDesc: Maximum IMU gyro angular rate magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.longDesc: If the magnitude of the IMU angular rate vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of rapid rotation rates and associated errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_LIM.longDesc: The ekf accel bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

EKF2_ABL_TAU.shortDesc: Accel bias learning inhibit time constant
EKF2_ABL_TAU.longDesc: The vector magnitude of angular rate and acceleration used to check if learning should be inhibited has a peak hold filter applied to it with an exponential decay. This parameter controls the time constant of the decay.

EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE.shortDesc: Process noise for IMU accelerometer bias prediction

EKF2_AGP0_CTRL.longDesc: Set bit 0 to enable the horizontal position fusion. Bit 1 is reserved for vertical position fusion, which is not implemented: the altitude is not fused, it only takes part when the global origin is first set from this source.

EKF2_AGP0_DELAY.shortDesc: Auxiliary global position sensor 0 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP0_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 0 fusion
EKF2_AGP0_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP0_ID.longDesc: Sensor ID for slot 0. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP0_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP0_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 0
EKF2_AGP0_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AGP1_CTRL.longDesc: Set bit 0 to enable the horizontal position fusion. Bit 1 is reserved for vertical position fusion, which is not implemented: the altitude is not fused, it only takes part when the global origin is first set from this source.

EKF2_AGP1_DELAY.shortDesc: Auxiliary global position sensor 1 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP1_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 1 fusion
EKF2_AGP1_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP1_ID.longDesc: Sensor ID for slot 1. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP1_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP1_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 1
EKF2_AGP1_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AGP2_CTRL.longDesc: Set bit 0 to enable the horizontal position fusion. Bit 1 is reserved for vertical position fusion, which is not implemented: the altitude is not fused, it only takes part when the global origin is first set from this source.

EKF2_AGP2_DELAY.shortDesc: Auxiliary global position sensor 2 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP2_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 2 fusion
EKF2_AGP2_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP2_ID.longDesc: Sensor ID for slot 2. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP2_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP2_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 2
EKF2_AGP2_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AGP3_CTRL.longDesc: Set bit 0 to enable the horizontal position fusion. Bit 1 is reserved for vertical position fusion, which is not implemented: the altitude is not fused, it only takes part when the global origin is first set from this source.

EKF2_AGP3_DELAY.shortDesc: Auxiliary global position sensor 3 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP3_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 3 fusion
EKF2_AGP3_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP3_ID.longDesc: Sensor ID for slot 3. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP3_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP3_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 3
EKF2_AGP3_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AGP_CTRL.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion

EKF2_AGP_DELAY.shortDesc: Aux global position estimator delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_AGP_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for aux global position fusion
EKF2_AGP_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for aux global position measurements
EKF2_AGP_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AID_MASK.shortDesc: Integer bitmask controlling data fusion and aiding methods
EKF2_AID_MASK.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Set to true to use GPS data if available 1 : Set to true to use optical flow data if available 2 : Set to true to inhibit IMU delta velocity bias estimation 3 : Set to true to enable vision position fusion 4 : Set to true to enable vision yaw fusion. Cannot be used if bit position 7 is true. 5 : Set to true to enable multi-rotor drag specific force fusion 6 : set to true if the EV observations are in a non NED reference frame and need to be rotated before being used 7 : Set to true to enable GPS yaw fusion. Cannot be used if bit position 4 is true.

EKF2_ANGERR_INIT.shortDesc: 1-sigma tilt angle uncertainty after gravity vector alignment

EKF2_ARSP_THR.longDesc: Airspeed data is fused for wind estimation if above this threshold. Set to 0 to disable airspeed fusion. For reliable wind estimation both sideslip (see EKF2_FUSE_BETA) and airspeed fusion should be enabled. Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles (or VTOLs in fixed-wing mode).

EKF2_ASPD_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum airspeed used for baro static pressure compensation

EKF2_ASP_DELAY.shortDesc: Airspeed measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_AVEL_DELAY.shortDesc: Auxiliary Velocity Estimate delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_AVEL_EN.shortDesc: Fuse the landing-target relative velocity as auxiliary velocity
EKF2_AVEL_EN.longDesc:
When enabled, EKF2 fuses the relative velocity published in landing_target_pose
(vx_rel, vy_rel) as a horizontal auxiliary velocity measurement. The data is
only fused when landing_target_pose.rel_vel_ekf2_valid is true.

EKF2_BARO_CTRL.longDesc: If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the barometric height measurements to estimate its height in addition to other height sources (if activated).

EKF2_BARO_DELAY.shortDesc: Barometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_BARO_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for barometric and GPS height fusion
EKF2_BARO_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_BCOEF_X.shortDesc: X-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation
EKF2_BCOEF_X.longDesc: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the forward/reverse axis when flying a multi-copter which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

EKF2_BCOEF_Y.shortDesc: Y-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation
EKF2_BCOEF_Y.longDesc: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the right/left axis when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

EKF2_BETA_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for synthetic sideslip fusion
EKF2_BETA_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_DECL_TYPE.shortDesc: Integer bitmask controlling handling of magnetic declination
EKF2_DECL_TYPE.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to enable functions. 0 : Set to true to use the declination from the geo_lookup library when the GPS position becomes available, set to false to always use the EKF2_MAG_DECL value. 1 : Set to true to save the EKF2_MAG_DECL parameter to the value returned by the EKF when the vehicle disarms.

EKF2_DELAY_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum delay of all the aiding sensors
EKF2_DELAY_MAX.longDesc: Defines the delay between the current time and the delayed-time horizon. This value should be at least as large as the largest EKF2_XXX_DELAY parameter.

EKF2_DRAG_CTRL.longDesc: Activate wind speed estimation using specific-force measurements and a drag model defined by EKF2_BCOEF_[XY] and EKF2_MCOEF. Only use on vehicles that have their thrust aligned with the Z axis and no thrust in the XY plane.

EKF2_DRAG_NOISE.shortDesc: Specific drag force observation noise variance
EKF2_DRAG_NOISE.longDesc: Used by the multi-rotor specific drag force model. Increasing this makes the multi-rotor wind estimates adjust more slowly.

EKF2_EVA_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for vision angle measurements
EKF2_EVA_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EVP_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for vision position fusion
EKF2_EVP_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_EVP_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for vision position measurements
EKF2_EVP_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EVV_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for vision velocity estimate fusion
EKF2_EVV_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_EVV_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for vision velocity measurements
EKF2_EVV_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EV_CTRL.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion 2 : 3D velocity fusion 3 : Yaw

EKF2_EV_DELAY.shortDesc: Vision Position Estimator delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_EV_NOISE_MD.longDesc: If set to 0 (default) the measurement noise is taken from the vision message and the EV noise parameters are used as a lower bound. If set to 1 the observation noise is set from the parameters directly,

EKF2_EV_POS_X.shortDesc: X position of VI sensor focal point in body frame
EKF2_EV_POS_X.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_POS_Y.shortDesc: Y position of VI sensor focal point in body frame
EKF2_EV_POS_Y.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_POS_Z.shortDesc: Z position of VI sensor focal point in body frame
EKF2_EV_POS_Z.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_QMIN.longDesc: External vision will only be started and fused if the quality metric is above this threshold. The quality metric is a completely optional field provided by some VIO systems.

EKF2_FUSE_BETA.longDesc: For reliable wind estimation both sideslip and airspeed fusion (see EKF2_ARSP_THR) should be enabled. Only applies to vehicles in fixed-wing mode or with airspeed fusion active. Note: side slip fusion is currently not supported for tailsitters.

EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ.shortDesc: Baro deadzone range for height fusion
EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ.longDesc: Sets the value of deadzone applied to negative baro innovations. Deadzone is enabled when EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ > 0.

EKF2_GND_MAX_HGT.shortDesc: Height above ground level for ground effect zone
EKF2_GND_MAX_HGT.longDesc: Sets the maximum distance to the ground level where negative baro innovations are expected.

EKF2_GPS_CHECK.longDesc: Each threshold value is defined by the parameter indicated next to the check. Drift and offset checks only run when the vehicle is on ground and stationary.

EKF2_GPS_CTRL.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Longitude and latitude fusion 1 : Altitude fusion 2 : 3D velocity fusion 3 : Dual antenna heading fusion

EKF2_GPS_DELAY.shortDesc: GPS measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_GPS_MODE.longDesc: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_GPS_POS_X.shortDesc: X position of GPS antenna in body frame
EKF2_GPS_POS_X.longDesc: Forward (roll) axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_POS_Y.shortDesc: Y position of GPS antenna in body frame
EKF2_GPS_POS_Y.longDesc: Right (pitch) axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_POS_Z.shortDesc: Z position of GPS antenna in body frame
EKF2_GPS_POS_Z.longDesc: Down (yaw) axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_P_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for GNSS position fusion
EKF2_GPS_P_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_GPS_V_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for GNSS velocity fusion
EKF2_GPS_V_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_GPS_YAW_OFF.shortDesc: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS

EKF2_GPS_YAW_RST.longDesc: After GNSS heading fusion fails, or the heading receiver reports spoofing or jamming, EKF2 waits this long before resetting yaw to the GNSS heading.

EKF2_GRAV_NOISE.shortDesc: Accelerometer measurement noise for gravity based observations

EKF2_GSF_TAS.shortDesc: Default value of true airspeed used in EKF-GSF AHRS calculation
EKF2_GSF_TAS.longDesc: If no airspeed measurements are available, the EKF-GSF AHRS calculation will assume this value of true airspeed when compensating for centripetal acceleration during turns. Set to zero to disable centripetal acceleration compensation during fixed wing flight modes.

EKF2_GYR_B_LIM.longDesc: The ekf gyro bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

EKF2_GYR_B_NOISE.shortDesc: Process noise for IMU rate gyro bias prediction

EKF2_GYR_NOISE.shortDesc: Rate gyro noise for covariance prediction

EKF2_HDG_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_HEAD_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for magnetic heading fusion

EKF2_HGT_MODE.shortDesc: Determines the primary source of height data used by the EKF
EKF2_HGT_MODE.longDesc: The range sensor option should only be used when for operation over a flat surface as the local NED origin will move up and down with ground level.

EKF2_HGT_REF.shortDesc: Determines the reference source of height data used by the EKF
EKF2_HGT_REF.longDesc: When multiple height sources are enabled at the same time, the height estimate will always converge towards the reference height source selected by this parameter. The range sensor and vision options should only be used when for operation over a flat surface as the local NED origin will move up and down with ground level. If GPS is set as reference but altitude fusion is disabled in EKF2_GPS_CTRL, the GPS altitude is still used to initiaize the bias of the other height sensors.

EKF2_IMU_POS_X.shortDesc: X position of IMU in body frame
EKF2_IMU_POS_X.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_IMU_POS_Y.shortDesc: Y position of IMU in body frame
EKF2_IMU_POS_Y.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_IMU_POS_Z.shortDesc: Z position of IMU in body frame
EKF2_IMU_POS_Z.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_MAG_ACCLIM.shortDesc: Horizontal acceleration threshold used for heading observability check
EKF2_MAG_ACCLIM.longDesc: The heading is assumed to be observable when the body acceleration is greater than this parameter when a global position/velocity aiding source is active.

EKF2_MAG_B_NOISE.shortDesc: Process noise for body magnetic field prediction

EKF2_MAG_CHECK.longDesc: Bitmask to set which check is used to decide whether the magnetometer data is valid. If GNSS data is received, the magnetic field is compared to a World Magnetic Model (WMM), otherwise an average value is used. This check is useful to reject occasional hard iron disturbance. Set bits to 1 to enable checks. Checks enabled by the following bit positions 0 : Magnetic field strength. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR 1 : Magnetic field inclination. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_INC 2 : Wait for GNSS to find the theoretical strength and inclination using the WMM

EKF2_MAG_CHK_INC.longDesc: Maximum allowed deviation from the expected magnetic field inclination to pass the check.

EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR.longDesc: Maximum allowed deviation from the expected magnetic field strength to pass the check.

EKF2_MAG_DELAY.shortDesc: Magnetometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_MAG_E_NOISE.shortDesc: Process noise for earth magnetic field prediction

EKF2_MAG_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for magnetometer XYZ component fusion
EKF2_MAG_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_MAG_TYPE.longDesc: Integer controlling the type of magnetometer fusion used - magnetic heading or 3-component vector. The fusion of magnetometer data as a three component vector enables vehicle body fixed hard iron errors to be learned, but requires a stable earth field. If set to 'Automatic' magnetic heading fusion is used when on-ground and 3-axis magnetic field fusion in-flight. If set to 'Magnetic heading' magnetic heading fusion is used at all times. If set to 'None' the magnetometer will not be used under any circumstance. If no external source of yaw is available, it is possible to use post-takeoff horizontal movement combined with GNSS velocity measurements to align the yaw angle. If set to 'Init' the magnetometer is only used to initalize the heading.

EKF2_MAG_YAWLIM.shortDesc: Yaw rate threshold used by automatic selection of magnetometer fusion method
EKF2_MAG_YAWLIM.longDesc: This parameter is used when the magnetometer fusion method is set automatically (EKF2_MAG_TYPE = 0). If the filtered yaw rate is greater than this parameter value, then the EKF will use 3-axis magnetomer fusion.

EKF2_MCOEF.shortDesc: Propeller momentum drag coefficient for multi-rotor wind estimation
EKF2_MCOEF.longDesc: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by the propellers when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed not speed squared and is produced because some of the air velocity normal to the propeller axis of rotation is lost when passing through the rotor disc. This  changes the momentum of the flow which creates a drag reaction force. When comparing un-ducted propellers of the same diameter, the effect is roughly proportional to the area of the propeller blades when viewed side on and changes with propeller selection. Momentum drag is significantly higher for ducted rotors. To account for the drag produced by the body which scales with speed squared, see documentation for the EKF2_BCOEF_X and EKF2_BCOEF_Y parameters. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the momentum drag model for both axis.

EKF2_MIN_OBS_DT.shortDesc: Minimum time of arrival delta between non-IMU observations before data is downsampled
EKF2_MIN_OBS_DT.longDesc: Baro and Magnetometer data will be averaged before downsampling, other data will be point sampled resulting in loss of information.

EKF2_MIN_RNG.shortDesc: Expected range finder reading when on ground
EKF2_MIN_RNG.longDesc: If the vehicle is on ground, is not moving as determined by the motion test and the range finder is returning invalid or no data, then an assumed range value of EKF2_MIN_RNG will be used by the terrain estimator so that a terrain height estimate is available at the start of flight in situations where the range finder may be inside its minimum measurements distance when on ground.

EKF2_MOVE_TEST.longDesc: Scales the threshold tests applied to IMU data used to determine if the vehicle is static or moving. See parameter descriptions for EKF2_GPS_CHECK and EKF2_MAG_TYPE for further information on the functionality affected by this parameter.

EKF2_MULTI_IMU.longDesc: Maximum number of IMUs to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_IMU_MODE 0.

EKF2_MULTI_MAG.longDesc: Maximum number of magnetometers to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_MAG_MODE 0.

EKF2_NOAID_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for non-aiding position hold

EKF2_NOAID_TOUT.longDesc: Maximum lapsed time from last fusion of measurements that constrain velocity drift before the EKF will report the horizontal nav solution as invalid

EKF2_OF_DELAY.shortDesc: Optical flow measurement delay relative to IMU measurements
EKF2_OF_DELAY.longDesc: Assumes measurement is timestamped at trailing edge of integration period

EKF2_OF_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for optical flow fusion
EKF2_OF_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_OF_GYR_SRC.shortDesc: Optical flow angular rate compensation source
EKF2_OF_GYR_SRC.longDesc: Auto: use gyro from optical flow message if available, internal gyro otherwise. Internal: always use internal gyro

EKF2_OF_N_MAX.longDesc: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the minimum

EKF2_OF_N_MIN.longDesc: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the maximum

EKF2_OF_POS_X.shortDesc: X position of optical flow focal point in body frame
EKF2_OF_POS_X.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_POS_Y.shortDesc: Y position of optical flow focal point in body frame
EKF2_OF_POS_Y.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_POS_Z.shortDesc: Z position of optical flow focal point in body frame
EKF2_OF_POS_Z.longDesc: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_QMIN.shortDesc: In air optical flow minimum quality
EKF2_OF_QMIN.longDesc: Optical Flow data will only be used in air if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN

EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND.shortDesc: On ground optical flow minimum quality
EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND.longDesc: Optical Flow data will only be used on the ground if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND

EKF2_PCOEF_XN.shortDesc: Static pressure position error coefficient for the negative X axis
EKF2_PCOEF_XN.longDesc: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during backwards flight, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_XP.shortDesc: Static pressure position error coefficient for the positive X axis
EKF2_PCOEF_XP.longDesc: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during forward flight, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_YN.shortDesc: Pressure position error coefficient for the negative Y axis
EKF2_PCOEF_YN.longDesc: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the negative Y (LH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the left, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_YP.shortDesc: Pressure position error coefficient for the positive Y axis
EKF2_PCOEF_YP.longDesc: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the positive Y (RH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the right, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_Z.shortDesc: Static pressure position error coefficient for the Z axis
EKF2_PCOEF_Z.longDesc: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the Z body axis.

EKF2_POS_LOCK.shortDesc: Enable constant position fusion while on ground
EKF2_POS_LOCK.longDesc: When enabled, constant position fusion is enabled when the vehicle is landeded if position has been initialized but has currently no vel/pos aiding.

EKF2_PREDICT_US.longDesc: EKF prediction period in microseconds. This should ideally be an integer multiple of the IMU time delta. Actual filter update will be an integer multiple of IMU update.

EKF2_REQ_FIX.longDesc: Minimum GPS fix type required for GPS usage.

EKF2_REQ_GPS_H.shortDesc: Required GPS health time on startup
EKF2_REQ_GPS_H.longDesc: Minimum continuous period without GPS failure required to mark a healthy GPS status. It can be reduced to speed up initialization, but it's recommended to keep this unchanged for a vehicle.

EKF2_REQ_HDRIFT.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal drift speed to use GPS

EKF2_REQ_NSATS.shortDesc: Required satellite count to use GPS

EKF2_REQ_SACC.shortDesc: Required speed accuracy to use GPS

EKF2_REQ_VDRIFT.shortDesc: Maximum vertical drift speed to use GPS

EKF2_RNGBC_DELAY.shortDesc: Ranging beacon measurement delay relative to IMU measurements

EKF2_RNGBC_GATE.shortDesc: Gate size for ranging beacon fusion
EKF2_RNGBC_GATE.longDesc: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_RNGBC_NOISE.shortDesc: Measurement noise for ranging beacon fusion
EKF2_RNGBC_NOISE.longDesc: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_RNG_AID.longDesc: If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the range finder measurements to estimate it's height even if range sensor is not the primary height source. It will only do so if conditions for range measurement fusion are met. This enables the range finder to be used during low speed and low altitude operation, eg takeoff and landing, where baro interference from rotor wash is excessive and can corrupt EKF state estimates. It is intended to be used where a vertical takeoff and landing is performed, and horizontal flight does not occur until above EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX. If vehicle motion causes repeated switching between the primary height sensor and range finder, an offset in the local position origin can accumulate. Also range finder measurements are less reliable and can experience unexpected errors. For these reasons, if accurate control of height relative to ground is required, it is recommended to use the MPC_ALT_MODE parameter instead, unless baro errors are severe enough to cause problems with landing and takeoff.

EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX.shortDesc: Maximum height above ground allowed for conditional range aid mode
