no aux channel is mapped and
no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_MAP_HVEL.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale horizontal velocity in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_PTCH.shortDesc: RC_MAP_AUX{N} to allow for gimbal pitch rate control in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_VVEL.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale vertical velocity in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_YAWR.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale yaw rate in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MIN_HVEL.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_VVEL.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_YAWR.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this rate.

MC_YAWRATE_D.longDesc: Yaw rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_YAWRATE_I.longDesc: Yaw rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_YAWRATE_K.longDesc:
Global gain of the controller.
This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
output = MC_YAWRATE_K * (MC_YAWRATE_P * error
+ MC_YAWRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_YAWRATE_D * error_derivative)
Set MC_YAWRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_YAWRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_YAWRATE_P.longDesc: Yaw rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_YAW_P.longDesc: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.shortDesc: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for yaw torque setpoint
MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.longDesc:
Reduces vibrations by lowering high frequency torque caused by rotor acceleration.
0 disables the filter

MC_YAW_WEIGHT.longDesc:
A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control.
Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority
in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for
stable hovering or 3D navigation.
For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no impact on the yaw gain.

MC_YR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Yaw rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.shortDesc: Timeout to allow the payload to execute the mission command
MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.longDesc:
Ensure:
gripper: NAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
has released before continuing mission.
winch: CMD_DO_WINCH
has delivered before continuing mission.
gimbal: CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW
has reached the commanded orientation before beginning to take pictures.

MIS_DIST_1WP.shortDesc: Maximal horizontal distance from Home to first waypoint
MIS_DIST_1WP.longDesc:
There will be a warning message if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIST_1WP from Home.
Has no effect on mission validity.
Set a value of zero or less to disable.

MIS_DIST_WPS.longDesc: Failsafe check to prevent running missions which are way too big. Set a value of zero or less to disable. The mission will not be started if any distance between two subsequent waypoints is greater than MIS_DIST_WPS.

MIS_LND_ABRT_ALT.longDesc:
Minimum altitude above landing point that the vehicle will climb to after an aborted landing.
Then vehicle will loiter in this altitude until further command is received.
Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles.

MIS_LTRMIN_ALT.longDesc: This is the minimum altitude the system will always obey. The intent is to stay out of ground effect. set to -1, if there shouldn't be a minimum loiter altitude

MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.shortDesc: Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items)
MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.longDesc:
If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction.
If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.

MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT.longDesc:
This is the relative altitude the system will take off to
if not otherwise specified.

MIS_TAKEOFF_REQ.longDesc: If set, the mission feasibility checker will check for a takeoff waypoint on the mission.

MIS_TKO_LAND_REQ.longDesc:
Specifies if a mission has to contain a takeoff and/or mission landing.
Validity of configured takeoffs/landings is checked independently of the setting here.
values: Require a takeoff and a landing
Require both a takeoff and a landing, or neither
Same as previous when landed, in-air require landing only if no valid VTOL approach is present

MIS_TKO_PREC.longDesc:
Keep the vehicle over the landing target during vertical takeoffs (multicopter and VTOL in hover),
using the landing target estimate. Requires the vision target estimator with bit 2 of
VTE_TASK_MASK set. Without a valid target estimate the takeoff is unchanged.

MIS_TKO_PREC_DLY.longDesc:
Time after the takeoff ramp is complete before a vertical takeoff setpoint may move
sideways onto the landing target. Gives the vehicle time to clear the pad. Only used with MIS_TKO_PREC.

MIS_YAW_ERR.shortDesc: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance

MIS_YAW_TMT.shortDesc: Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced
MIS_YAW_TMT.longDesc:
If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the
waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition.
Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target
yaw in wind. Disabled by default.

MNT_DO_STAB.longDesc:
Set to true for servo gimbal, false for passthrough.
This is required for a gimbal which is not capable of stabilizing itself
and relies on the IMU's attitude estimation.

MNT_FIXED_PITCH.shortDesc: Tracked pitch angle when in fixed mode (MNT_MODE_IN=5)

MNT_MAN_PITCH.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_ROLL.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_YAW.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAV_COMPID.shortDesc: Mavlink Component ID of the mount
MNT_MAV_COMPID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink protocol v2, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this component ID.

MNT_MAV_SYSID.shortDesc: Mavlink System ID of the mount
MNT_MAV_SYSID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink gimbal protocol v1, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this target ID.

MNT_MAX_PITCH.shortDesc: Max positive angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
MNT_MAX_PITCH.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).

MNT_MIN_PITCH.shortDesc: Min negative angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)
MNT_MIN_PITCH.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).

MNT_MODE_IN.longDesc:
This is the protocol used between the ground station and the autopilot.
Recommended is Auto, RC only or MAVLink gimbal protocol v2.
The rest will be deprecated.
values: Auto (RC and MAVLink gimbal protocol v2)

MNT_MODE_OUT.longDesc:
This is the protocol used between the autopilot and a connected gimbal.
Recommended is the MAVLink gimbal protocol v2 if the gimbal supports it.

MNT_MODE_OUT2.longDesc:
Optional second output, driven in parallel to MNT_MODE_OUT with the
same setpoints. This allows the gimbal driver to talk to a second
gimbal in addition to the primary one.

Set to Disabled if not used. The two outputs must use different modes.

MNT_OB_LOCK_MODE.shortDesc: Mixer value for selecting a locking mode
MNT_OB_LOCK_MODE.longDesc: if required for the gimbal (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_OB_NORM_MODE.shortDesc: Mixer value for selecting normal mode
MNT_OB_NORM_MODE.longDesc: if required by the gimbal (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_OFF_PITCH.shortDesc: Offset for pitch channel output in degrees

MNT_OFF_ROLL.shortDesc: Offset for roll channel output in degrees

MNT_OFF_YAW.shortDesc: Offset for yaw channel output in degrees

MNT_RANGE_PITCH.shortDesc: Range of pitch channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RANGE_ROLL.shortDesc: Range of roll channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RANGE_YAW.shortDesc: Range of yaw channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RATE_PITCH.shortDesc: Angular pitch rate for manual input in degrees/second
MNT_RATE_PITCH.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-pitch rate..pitch rate].

MNT_RATE_YAW.shortDesc: Angular yaw rate for manual input in degrees/second
MNT_RATE_YAW.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-yaw rate..yaw rate].

MNT_RC_IN_MODE.shortDesc: Input mode for RC gimbal input

MNT_TAU.shortDesc: Time constant for open-loop AUX gimbal control
MNT_TAU.longDesc:
Alpha filter time constant defining the convergence rate (in seconds) for open-loop AUX mount control

Use when no angular position feedback is available.
With MNT_MODE_OUT set to AUX, the mount operates in open-loop and directly commands the servo output.
Parameters must be tuned for the specific servo to approximate its speed and response.

MOTFAIL_OFF.longDesc: Check is triggered if `abs(FD_ACT_MOT_C2T * thrust - FD_ACT_OFF)` is above this value.

MOTFAIL_OVR_TIME.longDesc: Motor failure only triggers after MOTFAIL_OVER is exceeded for this time.

MOTFAIL_TIME.longDesc: Motor failure only triggers after current thresholds are exceeded for this time.

MOTFAIL_UND_TIME.longDesc: Motor failure only triggers after MOTFAIL_UNDER is exceeded for this time.

MOT_ORDERING.longDesc: Determines the motor ordering. This can be used for example in combination with a 4-in-1 ESC that assumes a motor ordering which is different from PX4. ONLY supported for Quads. When changing this, make sure to test the motor response without props first.

MOT_POLE_COUNT.shortDesc: Number of magnetic poles of the motors
MOT_POLE_COUNT.longDesc: Specify the number of magnetic poles of the motors. It is required to compute the RPM value from the eRPM returned with the ESC telemetry. Either get the number from the motor spec sheet or count the magnets on the bell of the motor (not the stator magnets). Typical motors for 5 inch props have 14 poles.

MOT_SLEW_MAX.shortDesc: Minimum motor rise time (slew rate limit)
MOT_SLEW_MAX.longDesc: Minimum time allowed for the motor input signal to pass through a range of 1000 PWM units. A value x means that the motor signal can only go from 1000 to 2000 PWM in maximum x seconds. Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

MPC_ACC_DECOUPLE.longDesc:
Set to decouple tilt from vertical acceleration.
This provides smoother flight but slightly worse tracking in position and auto modes.
Unset if accurate position tracking during dynamic maneuvers is more important than a smooth flight.

MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_ACC_HOR.shortDesc: Acceleration for autonomous and for manual modes
MPC_ACC_HOR.longDesc: When piloting manually, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX.longDesc:
MPC_POS_MODE
1 just deceleration
4 not used, use MPC_ACC_HOR instead

MPC_ACC_UP_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_ALT_MODE.longDesc:
Control height
0: relative earth frame origin which may drift due to sensors
1: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) which changes with terrain variation.
It will revert to relative earth frame if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid.
2: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) when stationary
and relative to earth frame when moving horizontally.
The speed threshold is MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY

MPC_AUTO_NUDGING.shortDesc: Enable stick nudging in autonomous modes
MPC_AUTO_NUDGING.longDesc:
Bitmask to enable pilot override of heading and position during auto modes.

Bit 0 - Yaw nudging: yaw stick rotates the heading in all auto types
(takeoff, mission, Return, hold, landing). The new heading is held until a
mode switch resets it.

Bit 1 - Land nudging: during autonomous landing the pitch/roll sticks move
the vehicle horizontally, the throttle stick amends the descent speed
(stick full up: 0, centered: MPC_LAND_SPEED, full down: 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED),
and the yaw stick rotates the heading.

Stick override must be disabled (set MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD = -1).

MPC_HOLD_DZ.shortDesc: Deadzone for sticks in manual piloted modes
MPC_HOLD_DZ.longDesc: Does not apply to manual throttle and direct attitude piloting by stick.

MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)
MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.longDesc: Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Direct velocity or MPC_ALT_MODE 2

MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z.shortDesc: Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

MPC_JERK_AUTO.longDesc:
Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change).
A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions but also limited agility.

MPC_JERK_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal and vertical jerk in Position/Altitude mode
MPC_JERK_MAX.longDesc:
Limit the maximum jerk (acceleration change) of the vehicle.
A lower value leads to smoother motions but limits agility.
Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit.
Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

MPC_LAND_ALT1.shortDesc: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend)
MPC_LAND_ALT1.longDesc:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value
between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" (or "MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN") and "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"

MPC_LAND_ALT2.shortDesc: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing)
MPC_LAND_ALT2.longDesc:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets
limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"

MPC_LAND_ALT3.shortDesc: Altitude for 3. step of slow landing
MPC_LAND_ALT3.longDesc:
If a valid distance sensor measurement to the ground is available,
limit descending velocity to "MPC_LAND_CRWL" below this altitude.

MPC_LAND_CRWL.longDesc: Used below MPC_LAND_ALT3 if distance sensor data is availabe.

MPC_LAND_RADIUS.longDesc:
When nudging is enabled (see MPC_LAND_RC_HELP), this controls
the maximum allowed horizontal displacement from the original landing point.

MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.shortDesc: Enable nudging based on user input during autonomous land routine
MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.longDesc:
Using stick input the vehicle can be moved horizontally and yawed.
The descend speed is amended:
stick full up - 0
stick centered - MPC_LAND_SPEED
stick full down - 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED
Manual override during auto modes has to be disabled to use this feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE).

MPC_MANTHR_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum collective thrust in Stabilized mode
MPC_MANTHR_MIN.longDesc:
The value is mapped to the lowest throttle stick position in Stabilized mode.
Too low collective thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
Airmode is used to keep torque authority with zero thrust (see MC_AIRMODE).

MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX.shortDesc: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized, Altitude and Altitude Cruise mode

MPC_MAN_Y_MAX.shortDesc: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode

MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.shortDesc: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant
MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.longDesc:
Not used in Stabilized mode
Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

MPC_POS_MODE.longDesc:
The supported sub-modes are:
Direct velocity:
Sticks directly map to velocity setpoints without smoothing.
Also applies to vertical direction and Altitude mode.
Useful for velocity control tuning.
Acceleration based:
Sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME.shortDesc: Enforced delay between arming and takeoff
MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME.longDesc: For altitude controlled modes the time from arming the motors until a takeoff is possible gets forced to be at least MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds to ensure the motors and propellers can sppol up and reach idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster. This delay is particularly useful for vehicles with slow motor spin-up e.g. because of large propellers.

MPC_THR_CURVE.shortDesc: Thrust curve mapping in Stabilized Mode
MPC_THR_CURVE.longDesc:
Defines how the throttle stick is mapped to collective thrust in Stabilized mode.
Rescale to hover thrust estimate:
Stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered throttle stick corresponds to the hover thrust estimator's output.
No rescale:
Directly map the stick 1:1 to the output.
Can be useful with very low hover thrust which leads to much distortion and the upper half getting sensitive.
Rescale to hover thrust parameter:
Similar to rescaling to the hover thrust estimate, but it uses the hover thrust parameter value (see MPC_THR_HOVER) instead of estimated value.
With MPC_THR_HOVER 0.5 it's equivalent to No rescale.

MPC_THR_HOVER.longDesc:
Mapped to center throttle stick in Stabilized mode (see MPC_THR_CURVE).
Used for initialization of the hover thrust estimator (see MPC_USE_HTE).
The estimated hover thrust is used as base for zero vertical acceleration in altitude control.
The hover thrust is important for land detection to work correctly.

MPC_THR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
MPC_THR_MAX.longDesc: Limit allowed thrust e.g. for indoor test of overpowered vehicle.

MPC_THR_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes
MPC_THR_MIN.longDesc:
Too low thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
With airmode enabled this parameters can be set to 0
while still keeping torque authority (see MC_AIRMODE).

MPC_THR_XY_MARG.longDesc:
Margin that is kept for horizontal control when higher priority vertical thrust is saturated.
To avoid completely starving horizontal control with high vertical error.

MPC_TILTMAX_AIR.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all velocity or acceleration controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_TILTMAX_LND.shortDesc: Maximum tilt during inital takeoff ramp
MPC_TILTMAX_LND.longDesc: Tighter tilt limit during takeoff to avoid tip over.

MPC_TKO_RAMP_T.longDesc:
Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower.
If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over.
A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

MPC_USE_HTE.shortDesc: Use hover thrust estimate for altitude control
MPC_USE_HTE.longDesc:
Disable to use the fixed parameter MPC_THR_HOVER instead of the hover thrust estimate in the position controller.
This parameter does not influence Stabilized mode throttle curve (see MPC_THR_CURVE).

MPC_VELD_LP.shortDesc: Velocity derivative low pass cutoff frequency
MPC_VELD_LP.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_LP.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_MANUAL.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint in Position mode
MPC_VEL_MANUAL.longDesc:
Must be smaller than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.
The maximum sideways and backward speed can be set differently
using MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE and MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK, respectively.

MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.shortDesc: Maximum backward velocity in Position mode
MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.longDesc:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.shortDesc: Maximum sideways velocity in Position mode
MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.longDesc:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

MPC_VEL_NF_BW.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_NF_FRQ.longDesc:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the velocity.
A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_XY_CRUISE.shortDesc: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes
MPC_XY_CRUISE.longDesc: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently

MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator
MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.longDesc:
The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly
reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the
error is above this parameter, the integration of the
trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone.
This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking
capabilities of the vehicle.

MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual position control stick exponential curve sensitivity
MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_XY_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal position error
MPC_XY_P.longDesc: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

MPC_XY_TRAJ_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error

MPC_XY_VEL_ALL.longDesc:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error
MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error
MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc:
Defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral
Allows to eliminate steady state errors in disturbances like wind.

MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all velocity controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error
MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.shortDesc: Maximum yaw acceleration in autonomous modes
MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.longDesc:
Limits the acceleration of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum yaw rate in autonomous modes
MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.longDesc:
Limits the rate of change of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.

MPC_YAW_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual control stick yaw rotation exponential curve
MPC_YAW_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_Z_ERR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum vertical error allowed by the trajectory generator
MPC_Z_ERR_MAX.longDesc:
Vertical analog of MPC_XY_ERR_MAX. When the smoothed trajectory z
leads the drone by more than this value, trajectory integration is
slowed down so the virtual setpoint can't walk away from the drone.
This suppresses altitude overshoots caused by a noisy altitude
reference (e.g. mission setpoint jittering as the home altitude
estimate is refined in flight). Set to 0 to disable the vertical
time-stretch.

MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual control stick vertical exponential curve
MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_Z_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical position error
MPC_Z_P.longDesc: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

MPC_Z_VEL_ALL.longDesc:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for vertical velocity error
MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for vertical velocity error
MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.
For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.
For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error
MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN.longDesc: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP.longDesc: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

NAV_ACC_RAD.longDesc:
Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set.
For fixed wing the npfg switch distance is used for horizontal acceptance.

NAV_DLL_ACT.shortDesc: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode
NAV_DLL_ACT.longDesc:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.

NAV_FORCE_VT.shortDesc: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land

NAV_FT_DST.longDesc: The distance in meters to follow the target at

NAV_FT_FS.longDesc: The side to follow the target from (front right = 0, behind = 1, front = 2, front left = 3)

NAV_FT_RS.shortDesc: Dynamic filtering algorithm responsiveness to target movement
NAV_FT_RS.longDesc: lower numbers increase the responsiveness to changing long lat but also ignore less noise

NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.shortDesc: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing
NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.longDesc:
Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller
than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.

NAV_GPSF_LT.longDesc: The time in seconds the system should do open loop loiter and wait for GPS recovery before it goes into flight termination. Set to 0 to disable.

NAV_GPSF_P.longDesc: Pitch in degrees during the open loop loiter

NAV_GPSF_R.longDesc: Roll in degrees during the loiter

NAV_GPSF_TR.longDesc: Thrust value which is set during the open loop loiter

NAV_LOITER_RAD.longDesc:
Default value of loiter radius in fixed-wing mode (e.g. for Loiter mode).
The direction of the loiter can be set via the sign: A positive value for
clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

NAV_LTR_LAST_DL.shortDesc: Loiter at last GCS heartbeat position on data link loss
NAV_LTR_LAST_DL.longDesc: If disabled, the vehicle loiters at its current position. Only applies to Hold mode during failsafe actions.

NAV_MIN_FT_HT.longDesc: The minimum height in meters relative to home for following a target

NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.shortDesc: Minimum height above ground during Mission and RTL
NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.longDesc:
Minimum height above ground the vehicle is allowed to descend to during Mission and RTL,
excluding landing commands.
Requires a distance sensor to be set up.
Note: only prevents the vehicle from descending further, but does not force it to climb.
Set to a negative value to disable.

NAV_MIN_LTR_ALT.longDesc:
This is the minimum altitude above Home the system will always obey in Loiter (Hold) mode if switched into this
mode without specifying an altitude (e.g. through Loiter switch on RC).
Doesn't affect Loiters that are part of Missions or that are entered through a reposition setpoint ("Go to").
Set to a negative value to disable.

NAV_RCL_ACT.shortDesc: Set manual control loss failsafe mode
NAV_RCL_ACT.longDesc:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

NAV_TRAFF_AVOID.longDesc:
Enabling this will allow the system to respond
to transponder data from e.g. ADSB transponders

NAV_TRAFF_A_HOR.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID horizontal distance

NAV_TRAFF_A_RADM.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID RADIUS MANNED
NAV_TRAFF_A_RADM.longDesc: Defines the Radius where NAV TRAFFIC AVOID is Called For Manned Aviation

NAV_TRAFF_A_RADU.longDesc: Defines the Radius where NAV TRAFFIC AVOID is Called For Unmanned Aviation

NAV_TRAFF_A_VER.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID vertical distance

NAV_TRAFF_COLL_T.longDesc:
Minimum acceptable time until collsion.
Assumes constant speed over 3d distance.

NPFG_DAMPING.longDesc: Damping ratio of NPFG control law.

NPFG_EN_MIN_GSP.shortDesc: Enable minimum forward ground speed maintaining excess wind handling logic

NPFG_GSP_MAX_TK.shortDesc: Maximum, minimum forward ground speed for track keeping in excess wind
NPFG_GSP_MAX_TK.longDesc: The maximum value of the minimum forward ground speed that may be commanded by the track keeping excess wind handling logic. Commanded in full at the normalized track error fraction of the track error boundary and reduced to zero on track.

NPFG_LB_PERIOD.shortDesc: Enable automatic lower bound on the NPFG period
NPFG_LB_PERIOD.longDesc:
Avoids limit cycling from a too aggressively tuned period/damping combination.
If false, also disables upper bound NPFG_PERIOD_UB.

NPFG_PERIOD_SF.longDesc:
Multiplied by period for conservative minimum period bounding (when period lower
bounding is enabled). 1.0 bounds at marginal stability.

NPFG_ROLL_TC.longDesc:
Time constant of roll controller command / response, modeled as first order delay.
Used to determine lower period bound. Setting zero disables automatic period bounding.

NPFG_SW_DST_MLT.longDesc:
Multiplied by the track error boundary to determine when the aircraft switches
to the next waypoint and/or path segment. Should be less than 1.

NPFG_TRACK_KEEP.shortDesc: Enable track keeping excess wind handling logic

NPFG_UB_PERIOD.shortDesc: Enable automatic upper bound on the NPFG period
NPFG_UB_PERIOD.longDesc: Adapts period to maintain track keeping in variable winds and path curvature.

NPFG_WIND_REG.longDesc: Disabling this parameter further disables all other airspeed incrementation options.

OSD_ATXXXX_CFG.longDesc: Configure the ATXXXX OSD Chip (mounted on the OmnibusF4SD board) and select the transmission standard.

OSD_CH_HEIGHT.longDesc:
Controls the vertical position of the crosshair display.
Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative
values will display the crosshairs below the horizon

OSD_CH_POS_HOR.longDesc:
Controls the horizontal position of the crosshair display.
Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative
values will display the crosshairs left of the center of the screen

OSD_CH_POS_VER.longDesc:
Controls the vertical position of the crosshair display.
Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative
values will display the crosshairs below the horizon

OSD_DWELL_TIME.longDesc: Amount of time in milliseconds to dwell at the beginning of the display, when scrolling.

OSD_LOG_LEVEL.longDesc: Minimum security of log level to display on the OSD.

OSD_RC_STICK.longDesc: Forward RC stick input to VTX when disarmed

OSD_SCROLL_RATE.longDesc:
Scroll rate in milliseconds for OSD messages longer than available character width.
This is lower-bounded by the nominal loop rate of this module.

PCF8583_MAGNET.longDesc: Nmumber of signals per rotation of actuator

PCF8583_POOL.longDesc: Determines how often the sensor is read out.

PCF8583_RESET.longDesc: Internal device counter is reset to 0 when overun this value, counter is able to store upto 6 digits reset of counter takes some time - measurement with reset has worse accurancy. 0 means reset counter after every measurement.

PD_GRIPPER_TO.shortDesc: Timeout for successful gripper actuation acknowledgement
PD_GRIPPER_TO.longDesc:
Maximum time Gripper will wait while the successful griper actuation isn't recognised.
If the gripper has no feedback sensor, it will simply wait for
this time before considering gripper actuation successful and publish a
'VehicleCommandAck' signaling successful gripper action

PLD_BTOUT.longDesc: Time after which the landing target is considered lost without any new measurements.

PLD_FAPPR_ALT.longDesc: Allow final approach (without horizontal positioning) if losing landing target closer than this to the ground.

PLD_HACC_RAD.longDesc: Start descending if closer above landing target than this.

PLD_MAX_SRCH.longDesc: Maximum number of times to search for the landing target if it is lost during the precision landing.

PLD_MOVING_T_MAX.longDesc:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the maximum time.

PLD_MOVING_T_MIN.longDesc:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the minimum time.

PLD_SRCH_ALT.longDesc: Altitude above home to which to climb when searching for the landing target.

PLD_SRCH_TOUT.longDesc: Time allowed to search for the landing target before falling back to normal landing.

PLD_YAW_EN.shortDesc: Set to true to control yaw while landing
PLD_YAW_EN.longDesc: Control the orientation when landing. The orientation comes from the topic vte_orientation.

PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.shortDesc: Tuning parameter for the pure pursuit controller
PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.longDesc: Lower value -> More aggressive controller (beware overshoot/oscillations)

PP_LOOKAHD_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

PP_LOOKAHD_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

PWM_AUX_OUT.shortDesc: PWM channels used as ESC outputs
PWM_AUX_OUT.longDesc: Number representing the channels e.g. 134 - Channel 1, 3 and 4. Global e.g. PWM_AUX_MIN/MAX/DISARM limits only apply to these channels.

PWM_AUX_RATE.longDesc: Set to 400 for industry default or 1000 for high frequency ESCs. Set to 0 for Oneshot125.

PWM_AUX_RATE1.longDesc: Set the default PWM output frequency for the aux outputs

PWM_AUX_REV1.longDesc: Enable to invert the channel. Warning: Use this parameter when connected to a servo only. For a brushless motor, invert manually two phases to reverse the direction.

RA_ACC_RAD_GAIN.longDesc:
The geometric ideal acceptance radius is multiplied by this factor
to account for kinematic and dynamic effects.
Higher value -> The rover starts to cut the corner earlier.

RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum acceptance radius for the waypoints
RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.longDesc:
The controller scales the acceptance radius based on the angle between
the previous, current and next waypoint.
Higher value -> smoother trajectory at the cost of how close the rover gets
to the waypoint (Set to -1 to disable corner cutting).

RA_WHEEL_BASE.longDesc: Distance from the front to the rear axle.

RBCLW_ADDRESS.longDesc: The Roboclaw can be configured to have an address from 0x80 to 0x87, inclusive. It must be configured to match this parameter.

RBCLW_BAUD.longDesc: Baud rate of the serial communication with the Roboclaw. The Roboclaw must be configured to match this rate.

RBCLW_COUNTS_REV.longDesc: Number of encoder counts for one revolution. The roboclaw treats analog encoders (potentiometers) as having 2047 counts per rev. The default value of 1200 corresponds to the default configuration of the Aion R1 rover.

RBCLW_READ_PER.longDesc: How long to wait, in Milliseconds, between reading wheel encoder values over Uart from the Roboclaw

RBCLW_SER_CFG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run Roboclaw Driver.

RBCLW_WRITE_PER.longDesc: How long to wait, in Milliseconds, between writing actuator controls over Uart to the Roboclaw

of channels which were used during RC calibration. It is only meant
for ground station use.

RC_ENG_MOT_TH.shortDesc: Threshold for selecting main motor engage
RC_ENG_MOT_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_FAILS_THR.longDesc:
Use RC_MAP_FAILSAFE to specify which channel is used to indicate RC loss via this threshold.
By default this is the throttle channel.
Set to a PWM value slightly above the PWM value for the channel (e.g. throttle) in a failsafe event,
but below the minimum PWM value for the channel during normal operation.
Note: The default value of 0 disables the feature (it is below the expected range).

RC_GEAR_TH.shortDesc: Threshold for the landing gear switch
RC_GEAR_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_KILLSWITCH_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_LOITER_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_MAN_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_MAP_ARM_SW.longDesc:
Use it to arm/disarm via switch instead of default throttle stick. If this is
assigned, arming and disarming via stick is disabled.

RC_MAP_ENG_MOT.shortDesc: RC channel to engage the main motor (for helicopters)

RC_MAP_FAILSAFE.longDesc:
Configures which RC channel is used by the receiver to indicate the signal was lost
(on receivers that use output a fixed signal value to report lost signal).
If set to 0, the channel mapped to throttle is used.
Use RC_FAILS_THR to set the threshold indicating lost signal. By default it's below
the expected range and hence disabled.

RC_MAP_FLTMODE.longDesc:
If this parameter is non-zero, flight modes are only selected
by this channel and are assigned to six slots.

RC_MAP_FLTM_BTN.longDesc:
This bitmask allows to specify multiple channels for changing flight modes using
momentary buttons. Each channel is assigned to a mode slot ((lowest channel = slot 1).
The resulting modes for each slot X is defined by the COM_FLTMODEX parameters.
The functionality can be used only if RC_MAP_FLTMODE is disabled.
The maximum number of available slots and hence bits set in the mask is 6.
bitmask: Mask Channel 1 as a mode button
Mask Channel 2 as a mode button
Mask Channel 3 as a mode button
Mask Channel 4 as a mode button
Mask Channel 5 as a mode button
Mask Channel 6 as a mode button
Mask Channel 7 as a mode button
Mask Channel 8 as a mode button
Mask Channel 9 as a mode button
Mask Channel 10 as a mode button
Mask Channel 11 as a mode button
Mask Channel 12 as a mode button
Mask Channel 13 as a mode button
Mask Channel 14 as a mode button
Mask Channel 15 as a mode button
Mask Channel 16 as a mode button
Mask Channel 17 as a mode button
Mask Channel 18 as a mode button

RC_MAP_KILL_SW.longDesc:
This channel immediately sets all outputs to their disarmed values, parachutes are NOT deployed.
Unlike termination this can be undone. Quickly flipping the switch back restores control.
System auto-disarms after COM_KILL_DISARM seconds, preflight checks and re-arming are then required.

RC_MAP_MODE_SW.longDesc:
This is the main flight mode selector.
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for deciding about the main mode.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_PARAM1.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 1st parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM2.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 2nd parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM3.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 3th parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PITCH.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading pitch inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_ROLL.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading roll inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_TERM_SW.longDesc:
This channel triggers irreversible flight termination:
All outputs are disabled and set to their failsafe values (disarmed by default)
and MAVLink parachutes are triggered.
Unlike a kill switch, this cannot be undone until system reboot. Use with caution.

RC_MAP_THROTTLE.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading throttle inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_YAW.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading yaw inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_OFFB_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_PAYLOAD_MIDTH.shortDesc: Threshold for mid position of payload power switch
RC_PAYLOAD_MIDTH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_PAYLOAD_TH.shortDesc: Threshold for on position of payload power switch
RC_PAYLOAD_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_PORT_CONFIG.shortDesc: Serial Configuration for RC Input Driver
RC_PORT_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run RC Input Driver. Setting this to 'Disabled' will use a board-specific default port for RC input.

RC_POSCTL_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_RETURN_TH.shortDesc: Threshold for selecting return to launch mode
RC_RETURN_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RC_RSSI_PWM_CHAN.shortDesc: PWM input channel that provides RSSI
RC_RSSI_PWM_CHAN.longDesc:
0: do not read RSSI from input channel
1-18: read RSSI from specified input channel
Specify the range for RSSI input with RC_RSSI_PWM_MIN and RC_RSSI_PWM_MAX parameters.

RC_RSSI_PWM_MAX.shortDesc: Max input value for RSSI reading

RC_RSSI_PWM_MIN.shortDesc: Min input value for RSSI reading

RC_STAB_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_TRANS_TH.shortDesc: Threshold for the VTOL transition switch
RC_TRANS_TH.longDesc:
0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits
0 : min
1 : max
sign indicates polarity of comparison
positive : true when channel>th
negative : true when channel<th

RD_MAX_THR_YAW_R.shortDesc: Yaw rate turning left/right wheels at max speed in opposite directions
RD_MAX_THR_YAW_R.longDesc: This parameter is used to calculate the feedforward term of the closed loop yaw rate control. The controller first calculates the required speed difference between the left and right motor to achieve the desired yaw rate. This desired speed difference is then linearly mapped to normalized motor commands. A good starting point is half the speed the rover drives at maximum throttle (RD_MAX_THR_SPD)). Increase this parameter if the rover turns faster than the setpoint, and decrease if the rover turns slower.

RD_MISS_SPD_GAIN.shortDesc: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction during waypoint transition
RD_MISS_SPD_GAIN.longDesc: The waypoint transition speed is calculated as: Transition_speed = Maximum_speed * (1 - normalized_transition_angle * RM_MISS_VEL_GAIN) The normalized transition angle is the angle between the line segment from prev-curr WP and curr-next WP interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1]. Higher value -> More speed reduction during waypoint transitions. Set to -1 to disable any speed reduction during waypoint transition.

RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.shortDesc: Yaw error threshhold to switch from driving to spot turning
RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.longDesc:
This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from driving to turning based on the
error between the desired and actual yaw. It is also used as the threshold whether the rover should come
to a smooth stop at the next waypoint. This slow down effect is active if the angle between the
line segments from prevWP-currWP and currWP-nextWP is smaller then 180 - RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.

RD_TRANS_TRN_DRV.shortDesc: Yaw error threshhold to switch from spot turning to driving
RD_TRANS_TRN_DRV.longDesc:
This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from turning to driving based on the
error between the desired and actual yaw.

RD_WHEEL_TRACK.longDesc: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

RD_YAW_STK_GAIN.shortDesc: Yaw stick gain for Manual mode
RD_YAW_STK_GAIN.longDesc: Assign value <1.0 to decrease stick response for yaw control.

RM_COURSE_CTL_TH.shortDesc: Threshold to update course control in manual position mode
RM_COURSE_CTL_TH.longDesc:
Threshold for the angle between the active cruise direction and the cruise direction given
by the stick inputs.
This can be understood as a deadzone for the combined stick inputs for forward/backwards
and lateral speed which defines a course direction.

RM_MAX_THR_YAW_R.shortDesc: Yaw rate turning left/right wheels at max speed in opposite directions
RM_MAX_THR_YAW_R.longDesc: This parameter is used to calculate the feedforward term of the closed loop yaw rate control. The controller first calculates the required speed difference between the left and right motor to achieve the desired yaw rate. This desired speed difference is then linearly mapped to normalized motor commands. A good starting point is half the speed the rover drives at maximum throttle (RD_MAX_THR_SPD)). Increase this parameter if the rover turns faster than the setpoint, and decrease if the rover turns slower.

RM_MISS_SPD_GAIN.shortDesc: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction during waypoint transition
RM_MISS_SPD_GAIN.longDesc: The waypoint transition speed is calculated as: Transition_speed = Maximum_speed * (1 - normalized_transition_angle * RM_MISS_VEL_GAIN) The normalized transition angle is the angle between the line segment from prev-curr waypoint and curr-next waypoint interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1]. Higher value -> More speed reduction during waypoint transitions. Set to -1 to disable any speed reduction during waypoint transition.

RM_WHEEL_TRACK.longDesc: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

RM_YAW_STK_GAIN.shortDesc: Yaw stick gain for Manual mode
RM_YAW_STK_GAIN.longDesc: Assign value <1.0 to decrease stick response for yaw control.

RO_ACCEL_LIM.longDesc:
Set to -1 to disable.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral acceleration.

RO_DECEL_LIM.longDesc:
Set to -1 to disable.
Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral deceleration.

RO_JERK_LIM.longDesc:
Set to -1 to disable.
Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes.
For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral jerk.

RO_MAX_THR_SPEED.shortDesc: Speed the rover drives at maximum throttle
RO_MAX_THR_SPEED.longDesc: Used to linearly map speeds [m/s] to throttle values [-1. 1].

RO_PARK_THR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum throttle in Manual Parking mode
RO_PARK_THR_MAX.longDesc: Scales the stick inputs that are mapped to motor commands in Manual Parking mode, so that maneuvering in tight spaces stays slow. Applies symmetrically to forward and reverse throttle.

RO_SPEED_I.shortDesc: Integral gain for ground speed controller

RO_SPEED_LIM.longDesc: Used to cap speed setpoints and map controller inputs to speed setpoints in Position mode.

RO_SPEED_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for ground speed controller

RO_SPEED_RED.shortDesc: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction based on the course error
RO_SPEED_RED.longDesc:
Reduced_speed = RO_MAX_THR_SPEED * (1 - normalized_course_error * RO_SPEED_RED)
The normalized course error is the angle between the current course and the bearing setpoint
interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1].
Higher value -> More speed reduction.
Note: This is also used to calculate the speed at which the vehicle arrives at a waypoint in auto modes.
Set to -1 to disable bearing error based speed reduction.

RO_SPEED_TH.longDesc:
Set to -1 to disable.
The minimum threshold for the speed measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

RO_YAW_ACCEL_LIM.longDesc:
Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can increase.
Set to -1 to disable.

RO_YAW_DECEL_LIM.longDesc:
Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can decrease.
Set to -1 to disable.

RO_YAW_EXPO.longDesc:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.
0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

RO_YAW_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw controller

RO_YAW_RATE_CORR.longDesc:
Multiplicative correction factor for the feedforward mapping of the yaw rate controller.
Increase this value (x > 1) if the measured yaw rate is lower than the setpoint, decrease (0 < x < 1) otherwise.
Note: Tuning this is particularly useful for skid-steered rovers, or rovers with misaligned wheels/steering axes
that cause a lot of friction when turning.

RO_YAW_RATE_I.shortDesc: Integral gain for closed loop yaw rate controller

RO_YAW_RATE_LIM.longDesc:
Used to cap yaw rate setpoints and map controller inputs to yaw rate setpoints
in Acro, Stabilized and Position mode.

RO_YAW_RATE_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw rate controller

RO_YAW_RATE_TH.longDesc: The minimum threshold for the yaw rate measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

RO_YAW_STICK_DZ.longDesc: Percentage of stick input range that will be interpreted as zero around the stick centered value.

RO_YAW_SUPEXPO.longDesc:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using RO_YAW_EXPO.
0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

RTL_APPR_FORCE.longDesc: Only consider RTL point, if it has an approach defined.

RTL_CONE_ANG.shortDesc: Half-angle of the return mode altitude cone
RTL_CONE_ANG.longDesc:
Defines the half-angle of a cone centered around the destination position that
affects the altitude at which the vehicle returns.
values: No cone, always climb to RTL_RETURN_ALT above destination.
Only climb to at least RTL_DESCEND_ALT above destination.

RTL_DESCEND_ALT.longDesc:
Descend to this altitude (above destination position) after return, and wait for time defined in RTL_LAND_DELAY.
Land (i.e. slowly descend) from this altitude if autolanding allowed.
VTOLs do transition to hover in this altitdue above the landing point.

RTL_FLT_TIME.shortDesc: Maximum allowed RTL flight in minutes
RTL_FLT_TIME.longDesc: This is used to determine when the vehicle should be switched to RTL due to low battery. Note, particularly for multirotors this should reflect flight time at cruise speed, not while stationary

RTL_LAND_DELAY.longDesc:
Delay before landing (after initial descent) in Return mode.
If set to -1 the system will not land but loiter at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

RTL_LOITER_RAD.longDesc: Set the radius for loitering to a safe altitude for VTOL transition.

RTL_MIN_DIST.shortDesc: Horizontal radius from return point within which special rules for return mode apply
RTL_MIN_DIST.longDesc:
The return altitude will be calculated based on RTL_CONE_ANG parameter.
The yaw setpoint will switch to the one defined by corresponding waypoint.

RTL_PLD_MD.longDesc:
Use precision landing when doing an RTL landing phase.
This setting does not apply for RTL destinations planned as part of a mission.

RTL_RETURN_ALT.longDesc:
Default minimum altitude above destination (e.g. home, safe point, landing pattern) for return flight.
The vehicle will climb to this altitude when Return mode is enganged, unless it currently is flying higher already.
This is affected by RTL_MIN_DIST and RTL_CONE_ANG.

RTL_TIME_FACTOR.shortDesc: RTL time estimate safety margin factor
RTL_TIME_FACTOR.longDesc:
Safety factor that is used to scale the actual RTL time estimate.
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

RTL_TIME_MARGIN.shortDesc: RTL time estimate safety margin offset
RTL_TIME_MARGIN.longDesc:
Margin that is added to the time estimate, after it has already been scaled
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

RTL_TYPE.longDesc: Return mode destination and flight path (home location, rally point, mission landing pattern, reverse mission)
values: Return to closest safe point (home or rally point) via direct path.

Return to closest safe point other than home (mission landing pattern or rally point), via direct path. If no mission landing or rally points are defined return home via direct path. Always chose closest safe landing point if vehicle is a VTOL in hover mode.
Return to a planned mission landing, if available, using the mission path, else return to home via the reverse mission path. Do not consider rally points.
Return via direct path to closest destination: home, start of mission landing pattern or safe point. If the destination is a mission landing pattern, follow the pattern to land.
Return to the planned mission landing, or to home via the reverse mission path, whichever is closer by counting waypoints. Do not consider rally points.

RTPS_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run FastRTPS.

RTPS_MAV_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink + FastRTPS.

RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL.shortDesc: Min airspeed scaling factor for takeoff
RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL.longDesc: Pitch up will be commanded when the following airspeed is reached: FW_AIRSPD_MIN * RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL

RWTO_HDG.shortDesc: Specifies which heading should be held during the runway takeoff ground roll
RWTO_HDG.longDesc: 0: airframe heading when takeoff is initiated 1: position control along runway direction (bearing defined from vehicle position on takeoff initiation to MAV_CMD_TAKEOFF position defined by operator)

RWTO_MAX_PITCH.longDesc: Fixed-wing settings are used if set to 0. Note that there is also a minimum pitch of 10 degrees during takeoff, so this must be larger if set.

RWTO_MAX_ROLL.longDesc: Roll is limited during climbout to ensure enough lift and prevents aggressive navigation before we're on a safe height.

RWTO_NAV_ALT.shortDesc: Altitude AGL at which we have enough ground clearance to allow some roll
RWTO_NAV_ALT.longDesc: Until RWTO_NAV_ALT is reached the plane is held level and only rudder is used to keep the heading (see RWTO_HDG). This should be below FW_CLMBOUT_DIFF if FW_CLMBOUT_DIFF > 0.

RWTO_NPFG_PERIOD.shortDesc: NPFG period while steering on runway

RWTO_NUDGE.shortDesc: Enable use of yaw stick for nudging the wheel during runway ground roll
RWTO_NUDGE.longDesc:
This is useful when map, GNSS, or yaw errors on ground are misaligned with what the operator intends for takeoff course.
Particularly useful for skinny runways or if the wheel servo is a bit off trim.

RWTO_PSP.shortDesc: Pitch setpoint during taxi / before takeoff rotation airspeed is reached
RWTO_PSP.longDesc:
A taildragger with steerable wheel might need to pitch up
a little to keep its wheel on the ground before airspeed
to takeoff is reached.

RWTO_RAMP_TIME.shortDesc: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff

RWTO_ROT_AIRSPD.longDesc:
The calibrated airspeed threshold during the takeoff ground roll when the plane should start rotating (pitching up).
Must be less than the takeoff airspeed, will otherwise be capped at the takeoff airpeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD).
If set <= 0.0, defaults to 0.9 * takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD)

RWTO_ROT_TIME.longDesc: This is the time desired to linearly ramp in takeoff pitch constraints during the takeoff rotation

SDLOG_ALGORITHM.longDesc: Selects the algorithm used for logfile encryption

SDLOG_BACKEND.longDesc: If no logging is set the logger will not be started. Set bits true to enable: 0: SD card logging 1: Mavlink logging

SDLOG_BOOT_BAT.longDesc: When enabled, logging will not start from boot if battery power is not detected (e.g. powered via USB on a test bench). This prevents extraneous flight logs from being created during bench testing. Note that this only applies to log-from-boot modes. This has no effect on arm-based modes.

SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum number of log directories to keep
SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.longDesc: If there are more log directories than this value, the system will delete the oldest directories during startup. In addition, the system will delete old logs if there is not enough free space left. The minimum amount is 300 MB. If this is set to 0, old directories will only be removed if the free space falls below the minimum. Note: this does not apply to mission log files.

SDLOG_EXCH_KEY.longDesc: If the logfile is encrypted using a symmetric key algorithm, the used encryption key is generated at logging start and stored on the sdcard RSA2048 encrypted using this key.

SDLOG_KEY.longDesc: Selects the key in keystore, used for encrypting the log. When using a symmetric encryption algorithm, the key is generated at logging start and kept stored in this index. For symmetric algorithms, the key is volatile and valid only for the duration of logging. The key is stored in encrypted format on the sdcard alongside the logfile, using an RSA2048 key defined by the SDLOG_EXCHANGE_KEY

SDLOG_MAX_SIZE.longDesc: Maximum size of a single log file in mebibytes (1 MiB = 1024 * 1024 bytes). When reached, the log file is closed and a new one is started. This value is also added to the cleanup threshold (see SDLOG_ROTATE) to reserve headroom for the next log file. A value of 0 disables both file rotation and the cleanup reservation. Must stay below the FAT32 file size limit of 4 GiB.

SDLOG_MISSION.longDesc: If enabled, a small additional "mission" log file will be written to the SD card. The log contains just those messages that are useful for tasks like generating flight statistics and geotagging. The different modes can be used to further reduce the logged data (and thus the log file size). For example, choose geotagging mode to only log data required for geotagging. Note that the normal/full log is still created, and contains all the data in the mission log (and more).

SDLOG_MODE.longDesc: Determines when to start and stop logging. By default, logging is started when arming the system, and stopped when disarming. Note: The logging start/end points that can be configured here only apply to SD logging. The mavlink backend is started/stopped independently of these points.

SDLOG_PROFILE.longDesc: This integer bitmask controls the set and rates of logged topics. The default allows for general log analysis while keeping the log file size reasonably small. Enabling multiple sets leads to higher bandwidth requirements and larger log files. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Default set (used for general log analysis) 1 : Full rate estimator (EKF2) replay topics 2 : Topics for thermal calibration (high rate raw IMU and Baro sensor data) 3 : Topics for system identification (high rate actuator control and IMU data) 4 : Full rates for analysis of fast maneuvers (RC, attitude, rates and actuators) 5 : Debugging topics (debug_*.msg topics, for custom code) 6 : Topics for sensor comparison (low rate raw IMU, Baro and magnetometer data) 7 : Topics for computer vision and collision prevention 8 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Gyro) 9 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Accel) 10: Logging of mavlink tunnel message (useful for payload communication debugging)

SDLOG_ROTATE.longDesc: The limit includes the log being written. Oldest logs are deleted at log start (not boot), leaving room for a file of up to SDLOG_MAX_SIZE, so logs can be downloaded before deletion. 100 lets logs fill the disk. Set to 0 to disable.

SDLOG_UTC_OFFSET.longDesc: the difference in hours and minutes from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) for a your place and date. for example, In case of South Korea(UTC+09:00), UTC offset is 540 min (9*60) refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UTC_time_offsets

SDLOG_UUID.longDesc: If set to 1, add an ID to the log, which uniquely identifies the vehicle

SENS_BARO_RATE.longDesc:
Barometric air data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual barometric data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

SENS_BAR_AUTOCAL.longDesc: Automatically calibrate barometer based on the GNSS height

SENS_BOARD_ROT.longDesc: This parameter defines the rotation of the FMU board relative to the platform.

SENS_BOARD_X_OFF.longDesc:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF.longDesc:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
This parameter gets set during the "level horizon" calibration or can be
set manually.

SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF.longDesc:
Rotation from flight controller board to vehicle body frame.
Has to be set manually (not set by any calibration).

SENS_CM8JL65_CFG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run Lanbao PSK-CM8JL65-CC5.

SENS_CM8JL65_R_0.longDesc: Distance Sensor Rotation as MAV_SENSOR_ORIENTATION enum

SENS_DPRES_ANSC.longDesc:
Pick the appropriate scaling from the datasheet.
this number defines the (linear) conversion from voltage
to Pascal (pa). For the MPXV7002DP this is 1000.
NOTE: If the sensor always registers zero, try switching
the static and dynamic tubes.

SENS_DPRES_REV.longDesc:
Reverse the raw measurements of all differential pressure sensors.
This can be enabled if the sensors have static and dynamic ports swapped.

SENS_EN_BATT.shortDesc: SMBUS Smart battery driver BQ40Z50 and BQ40Z80

SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB.longDesc: Probe for optional external I2C devices.

SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.shortDesc: Maximum height above ground when reliant on optical flow
SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.longDesc:
This parameter defines the maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The height setpoint will be limited to be no greater than this value when the navigation system
is completely reliant on optical flow data and the height above ground estimate is valid.
The sensor may be usable above this height, but accuracy will progressively degrade.

SENS_FLOW_MAXR.shortDesc: Magnitude of maximum angular flow rate reliably measurable by the optical flow sensor
SENS_FLOW_MAXR.longDesc:
Optical flow data will not fused by the estimators if the magnitude of the flow rate exceeds this value and
control loops will be instructed to limit ground speed such that the flow rate produced by movement over ground
is less than 50% of this value.

SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.shortDesc: Minimum height above ground when reliant on optical flow
SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.longDesc:
This parameter defines the minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably.
The sensor may be usable below this height, but accuracy will progressively reduce to loss of focus.

SENS_FLOW_RATE.longDesc:
Optical flow data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound,
actual optical flow data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

SENS_FLOW_ROT.longDesc:
This parameter defines the yaw rotation of the optical flow relative to the vehicle body frame.
Zero rotation is defined as X on flow board pointing towards front of vehicle.

SENS_GNSS0_AUXX.longDesc:
Forward axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity, of the receiver's second antenna.
Used when SENS_GNSS0_HDG is Dual antenna.

SENS_GNSS0_AUXY.longDesc:
Right axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity, of the receiver's second antenna.
Used when SENS_GNSS0_HDG is Dual antenna.

SENS_GNSS0_AUXZ.longDesc:
Down axis relative to vehicle centre of gravity, of the receiver's second antenna.
Used when SENS_GNSS0_HDG is Dual antenna.

SENS_GNSS0_DELAY.longDesc:
GPS measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.
Matched to physical GPS receiver via SENS_GNSS0_ID.
Only applied when the GPS driver does not provide its own

SENS_GNSS0_HDG.longDesc:
How the receiver in slot 0 (matched via SENS_GNSS0_ID) measures its dual antenna heading.
The heading is the bearing of the baseline between two antennas, and is only used when the
baseline length the receiver reports is within 20% of the configured one.
Moving base rover: this receiver is the rover of a moving base pair, the moving base is the
receiver in the other slot. The baseline runs from the moving base's antenna to this
receiver's antenna (SENS_GNSSn_OFFX/Y/Z of both slots).
Dual antenna: this receiver has two antennas. The baseline runs from its main antenna
(SENS_GNSS0_OFFX/Y/Z) to its auxiliary antenna (SENS_GNSS0_AUXX/Y/Z).

SENS_GNSS0_ID.longDesc:

SENS_GNSS1_AUXY.longDesc:

SENS_GNSS1_AUXZ.longDesc:

SENS_GNSS_PRIME.longDesc: The primary receiver is used while it passes the strict checks (GNSS_REQ_*), and while disarmed whenever it publishes. In flight, the other receiver is used when the primary fails its checks (GNSS_CHECK) or stops publishing for 2 s, and then for the rest of the flight unless it fails too. The other receiver is also used once it has been better through a hold: when the primary failed the strict checks while the other passed them, or when the primary was usable for a clearly smaller share of the last 10 s or so (availability lower by 0.2). The primary is used again once it has been better through the hold. The hold is 10 s and doubles with every such switch in a flight, so the first return takes 20 s. With Auto, the moving base of a moving base pair (SENS_GNSSn_HDG) is the primary. Without a primary, a receiver that passes the strict checks is preferred, and among those one with an RTK fixed solution. To make a DroneCAN receiver the primary, set its node ID (2 to 127). GPS_RAW_INT reports the primary receiver, or the first receiver to publish if there is no primary.

SENS_GPS_MASK.longDesc:
Set bits in the following positions to set which GPS accuracy metrics will be used to calculate the blending weight. Set to zero to disable and always used first GPS instance.
0 : Set to true to use speed accuracy
1 : Set to true to use horizontal position accuracy
2 : Set to true to use vertical position accuracy

SENS_GPS_PRIME.longDesc:
When no blending is active, this defines the preferred GPS receiver instance.
The GPS selection logic waits until the primary receiver is available to
send data to the EKF even if a secondary instance is already available.
The secondary instance is then only used if the primary one times out.
To have an equal priority of all the instances, set this parameter to -1 and
the best receiver will be used.
This parameter has no effect if blending is active.

SENS_GPS_TAU.longDesc: Sets the longest time constant that will be applied to the calculation of GPS position and height offsets used to correct data from multiple GPS data for steady state position differences.

SENS_MAG_SIDES.shortDesc: Bitfield selecting mag sides for calibration

recommended.
Bits:
ORIENTATION_TAIL_DOWN = 1
ORIENTATION_NOSE_DOWN = 2
ORIENTATION_LEFT = 4
ORIENTATION_RIGHT = 8
ORIENTATION_UPSIDE_DOWN = 16
ORIENTATION_RIGHTSIDE_UP = 32

SEP_AUTO_CONFIG.longDesc:
By default, the receiver is automatically configured. Sometimes it may be used for multiple purposes.
If the offered parameters aren't sufficient, this parameter can be disabled to have full control of the receiver configuration.
A good way to use this is to enable automatic configuration, let the receiver be configured, and then disable it to make manual adjustments.

SEP_CONST_USAGE.longDesc:
Choice of which constellations the receiver should use for PVT computation.
When this is 0, the constellation usage isn't changed.

SEP_DUMP_COMM.longDesc:
Log raw communication between the driver and connected receivers.
For example, "To receiver" will log all commands and corrections sent by the driver to the receiver.

SEP_HARDW_SETUP.shortDesc: Setup and expected use of the hardware
SEP_HARDW_SETUP.longDesc:
Setup and expected use of the hardware.
- Default: Use two receivers as completely separate instances.
- Moving base: Use two receivers in a rover & moving base setup for heading.

SEP_LOG_FORCE.shortDesc: Whether to overwrite or add to existing logging
SEP_LOG_FORCE.longDesc: When the receiver is already set up to log data, this decides whether extra logged data should be added or overwrite existing data.

SEP_LOG_HZ.longDesc: Select the frequency at which the connected receiver should log data to its internal storage.

SEP_LOG_LEVEL.longDesc: Select the level of detail that needs to be logged by the receiver.

SEP_OUTP_HZ.shortDesc: Output frequency of main SBF blocks
SEP_OUTP_HZ.longDesc: The output frequency of the main SBF blocks needed for PVT information.

SEP_PITCH_OFFS.shortDesc: Pitch offset for dual antenna GPS
SEP_PITCH_OFFS.longDesc:
Vertical offsets can be compensated for by adjusting the Pitch offset.
Note that this can be interpreted as the "roll" angle in case the antennas are aligned along the perpendicular axis.
This occurs in situations where the two antenna ARPs may not be exactly at the same height in the vehicle reference frame.
Since pitch is defined as the right-handed rotation about the vehicle Y axis,
a situation where the main antenna is mounted lower than the aux antenna (assuming the default antenna setup) will result in a positive pitch.

SEP_SAT_INFO.longDesc: Enable publication of satellite info (ORB_ID(satellite_info)) if possible.

SEP_STREAM_LOG.shortDesc: Logging stream used during automatic configuration
SEP_STREAM_LOG.longDesc:
The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the logging data.
Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

SEP_STREAM_MAIN.shortDesc: Main stream used during automatic configuration
SEP_STREAM_MAIN.longDesc:
The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the main data.
Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

SEP_YAW_OFFS.shortDesc: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS
SEP_YAW_OFFS.longDesc:
Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation.
Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction
of the vehicle and the rover antenna is in front.
The offset angle increases clockwise.
Set this to 90 if the rover antenna is placed on the
right side of the vehicle and the moving base antenna is on the left side.
