SIH_IXX.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IXY.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IXZ.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IYY.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IYZ.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IZZ.longDesc:
The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix.
It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_KDV.longDesc:
Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules.
The greater this value, the slower the quad will move.
Drag force function of velocity: D=-KDV*V.
The maximum freefall velocity can be computed as V=10*MASS/KDV [m/s]

SIH_KDW.longDesc:
Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules during rotations.
The greater this value, the slower the quad will rotate.
Aerodynamic moment function of body rate: Ma=-KDW*W_B.
This value can be set to 0 if unknown.

SIH_LOC_H0.longDesc:
This value represents the Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL) altitude where the simulation begins.
If using FlightGear as a visual animation,
this value can be tweaked such that the vehicle lies on the ground at takeoff.
LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LAT0.longDesc:
This value represents the North-South location on Earth where the simulation begins.
LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LON0.longDesc:
This value represents the East-West location on Earth where the simulation begins.
LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others
to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_MU_X.shortDesc: North magnetic field at the initial location
SIH_LOC_MU_X.longDesc: This value represents the North magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_MU_Y.shortDesc: East magnetic field at the initial location
SIH_LOC_MU_Y.longDesc: This value represents the East magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_MU_Z.shortDesc: Down magnetic field at the initial location
SIH_LOC_MU_Z.longDesc: This value represents the Down magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_YAW0.shortDesc: Initial heading (yaw) of the simulated vehicle
SIH_LOC_YAW0.longDesc: This value represents the initial heading (yaw) of the simulated vehicle at the start of the simulation.

SIH_L_PITCH.longDesc:
This is the arm length generating the pitching moment
This value can be measured with a ruler.
This corresponds to half the distance between the front and rear motors.

SIH_L_ROLL.longDesc:
This is the arm length generating the rolling moment
This value can be measured with a ruler.
This corresponds to half the distance between the left and right motors.

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_X.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_Y.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_Z.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MASS.longDesc: This value can be measured by weighting the quad on a scale.

SIH_Q_MAX.longDesc:
This is the maximum torque delivered by one propeller
when the motor is running at full speed.
This value is usually about few percent of the maximum thrust force.

SIH_RNGBC_NOISE.shortDesc: Ranging beacon measurement noise standard deviation
SIH_RNGBC_NOISE.longDesc: Gaussian noise added to simulated ranging beacon measurements. Set to 0 to disable noise.

SIH_T_MAX.longDesc:
This is the maximum force delivered by one propeller
when the motor is running at full speed.
This value is usually about 5 times the mass of the quadrotor.

SIH_T_TAU.longDesc: the time taken for the thruster to step from 0 to 100% should be about 4 times tau

SIM_AGP_FAIL.longDesc:
Stuck: freeze the measurement to the current location
Drift: add a linearly growing bias to the sensor data

SIM_ARSPD_FAIL.shortDesc: Dynamically simulate failure of airspeed sensor instance

SIM_BAT1_DRAIN.longDesc:
Time in seconds for simulated battery 1 to drain from 100% to 0% while armed,
overriding SIM_BAT_DRAIN for this battery only. A non-positive value uses SIM_BAT_DRAIN.
Only has an effect if battery 1 is enabled through BAT1_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT1_MIN_PCT.longDesc:
Lowest state of charge simulated battery 1 drains down to, overriding
SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT for this battery only. Set to -1 to use SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.
Only has an effect if battery 1 is enabled through BAT1_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT2_DRAIN.longDesc:
Time in seconds for simulated battery 2 to drain from 100% to 0% while armed,
overriding SIM_BAT_DRAIN for this battery only. A non-positive value uses SIM_BAT_DRAIN.
Only has an effect if battery 2 is enabled through BAT2_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT2_MIN_PCT.longDesc:
Lowest state of charge simulated battery 2 drains down to, overriding
SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT for this battery only. Set to -1 to use SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.
Only has an effect if battery 2 is enabled through BAT2_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT3_DRAIN.longDesc:
Time in seconds for simulated battery 3 to drain from 100% to 0% while armed,
overriding SIM_BAT_DRAIN for this battery only. A non-positive value uses SIM_BAT_DRAIN.
Only has an effect if battery 3 is enabled through BAT3_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT3_MIN_PCT.longDesc:
Lowest state of charge simulated battery 3 drains down to, overriding
SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT for this battery only. Set to -1 to use SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.
Only has an effect if battery 3 is enabled through BAT3_SOURCE.

SIM_BAT_ENABLE.longDesc:
Enable or disable the internal battery simulation. This is useful
when the battery is simulated externally and interfaced with PX4
through MAVLink for example.

SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.longDesc:
Can be used to alter the battery level during SITL- or HITL-simulation on the fly.
Particularly useful for testing different low-battery behaviour.

SIM_GPS_USED.shortDesc: simulated GPS number of satellites used

SYS_AUTOCFG_CAL.longDesc:
If enabled, a SYS_AUTOCONFIG reset overwrites stored sensor calibration with the airframe's built-in defaults.
Enable when the airframe ships its own calibration.

SYS_AUTOCONFIG.longDesc:
Set to 1 to reset parameters on next system startup (setting defaults).
Platform-specific values are used if available.
RC* parameters are preserved.

SYS_AUTOSTART.longDesc: CHANGING THIS VALUE REQUIRES A RESTART. Defines the auto-start script used to bootstrap the system.

SYS_BL_UPDATE.longDesc:
If enabled, update the bootloader on the next boot.
WARNING: do not cut the power during an update process, otherwise you will
have to recover using some alternative method (e.g. JTAG).
Instructions:
- Insert an SD card
- Enable this parameter
- Reboot the board (plug the power or send a reboot command)
- Wait until the board comes back up (or at least 2 minutes)
- If it does not come back, check the file bootlog.txt on the SD card

SYS_CAL_ACCEL.shortDesc: Enable auto start of accelerometer thermal calibration at the next power up
SYS_CAL_ACCEL.longDesc:
0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.
default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_BARO.shortDesc: Enable auto start of barometer thermal calibration at the next power up
SYS_CAL_BARO.longDesc:
0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.
default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_GYRO.shortDesc: Enable auto start of rate gyro thermal calibration at the next power up
SYS_CAL_GYRO.longDesc:
0 : Set to 0 to do nothing
1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot
This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts.
default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_TDEL.shortDesc: Required temperature rise during thermal calibration
SYS_CAL_TDEL.longDesc:
A temperature increase greater than this value is required during calibration.
Calibration will complete for each sensor when the temperature increase above the starting temperature exceeds the value set by SYS_CAL_TDEL.
If the temperature rise is insufficient, the calibration will continue indefinitely and the board will need to be repowered to exit.

SYS_CAL_TMAX.shortDesc: Maximum starting temperature for thermal calibration
SYS_CAL_TMAX.longDesc: Temperature calibration will not start if the temperature of any sensor is higher than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMAX.

SYS_CAL_TMIN.shortDesc: Minimum starting temperature for thermal calibration
SYS_CAL_TMIN.longDesc: Temperature calibration for each sensor will ignore data if the temperature is lower than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMIN.

SYS_DM_BACKEND.longDesc:
If the board supports persistent storage (i.e., the KConfig variable DATAMAN_PERSISTENT_STORAGE is set),
the 'Default storage' backend uses a file on persistent storage. If not supported, this backend uses
non-persistent storage in RAM.

SYS_FAC_CAL_MODE.longDesc:
If enabled, future sensor calibrations will be stored to /fs/mtd_caldata.
Note: this is only supported on boards with a separate calibration storage
/fs/mtd_caldata.

SYS_FAILURE_EN.longDesc:
If enabled allows MAVLink INJECT_FAILURE commands.
WARNING: the failures can easily cause crashes and are to be used with caution!

SYS_FAIL_BAT_LVL.longDesc:
Battery warning level reported while a battery 'wrong' failure
injection is active. The injected remaining charge is set just below
the matching threshold (BAT_LOW_THR, BAT_CRIT_THR or
BAT_EMERGEN_THR).

SYS_FAIL_GPS_JAM.longDesc:
GNSS jamming state reported by the addressed receiver while a GPS 'wrong'
failure injection is active. The reported position is left untouched, so
'Detected' simulates a receiver that still delivers a valid fix while
reporting interference. Leave at 'Unchanged' to keep the simulated
receiver's own jamming state.

SYS_FAIL_GPS_WRG.longDesc:
GNSS fix type reported by the addressed receiver while a GPS 'wrong'
failure injection is active. The reported position is left untouched.
The default 2D fix is rejected by the estimator, which requires a 3D
fix, and makes the GNSS redundancy check report a lost fix. Values above
3D fix report a better solution than the receiver really has.

SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.shortDesc: Instances failed by the RC switch
SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.longDesc:
Bitmask of instances of SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT that the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger
affects (bit 0 = instance 1, motor number for motors). 0 = all instances.

SYS_FAIL_RC_MODE.shortDesc: Failure type applied by the RC switch
SYS_FAIL_RC_MODE.longDesc:
How SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT fails when the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger fires, on SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.
unsupported (unit, type) pairs are ignored.

SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC.shortDesc: RC aux input that triggers failure injection

SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT.shortDesc: Component failed by the RC switch
SYS_FAIL_RC_UNIT.longDesc:
Which component the SYS_FAIL_RC_SRC trigger fails, with SYS_FAIL_RC_MODE on
SYS_FAIL_RC_INST.

SYS_HAS_BARO.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has a barometer
SYS_HAS_BARO.longDesc:
Disable this if the board has no barometer, such as some of the Omnibus
F4 SD variants.
If disabled, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of a
barometer.

SYS_HAS_GPS.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has a GPS
SYS_HAS_GPS.longDesc:
Disable this if the system has no GPS.
If disabled, the sensors hub will not process sensor_gps,
and GPS will not be available for the rest of the system.

SYS_HAS_MAG.shortDesc: Control if and how many magnetometers are expected
SYS_HAS_MAG.longDesc:
0: System has no magnetometer, preflight checks should pass without one.
1-N: Require the presence of N magnetometer sensors for check to pass.

SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has an airspeed sensor
SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD.longDesc:
Set this to 0 if the board has no airspeed sensor.
If set to 0, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of an
airspeed sensor.

SYS_HAS_NUM_DIST.shortDesc: Number of distance sensors to check being available
SYS_HAS_NUM_DIST.longDesc:
The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of distance sensors with valid data is present.
Disable the check with 0.

SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS.shortDesc: Control if and how many GNSS receivers are required
SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS.longDesc:
0: No minimum receiver count required. Position divergence between two receivers
and loss of a GNSS receiver still produce a warning but never trigger the
COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT failsafe action.
1-N: Require the presence of N GNSS receivers for arming.
If the active count drops below this value in flight, COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT is triggered.
When set to 2, position divergence between the two receivers also blocks arming when not armed and triggers COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT in flight.

SYS_HAS_NUM_OF.shortDesc: Number of optical flow sensors required to be available
SYS_HAS_NUM_OF.longDesc: The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of optical flow sensors with valid data are present.

SYS_HITL.shortDesc: Enable HITL/SIH mode on next boot
SYS_HITL.longDesc:
While enabled the system will boot in Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL)
or Simulation-In-Hardware (SIH) mode and not enable all sensors and checks.
When disabled the same vehicle can be flown normally.
Set to 'external HITL', if the system should perform as if it were a real
vehicle (the only difference to a real system is then only the parameter
value, which can be used for log analysis).

SYS_MC_EST_GROUP.longDesc: Set the group of estimators used for multicopters and VTOLs

SYS_PARAM_VER.longDesc:
This is used internally only: an airframe configuration might set an expected
parameter version value via PARAM_DEFAULTS_VER. This is checked on bootup
against SYS_PARAM_VER, and if they do not match, parameters are reset and
reloaded from the airframe configuration.

SYS_RESTART_TYPE.longDesc: Set by px4io to indicate type of restart

SYS_RGB_MAXBRT.longDesc: Set to 0 to disable, 1 for maximum brightness

SYS_TIME_SRC.shortDesc: Select the source of the system time
SYS_TIME_SRC.longDesc:
This parameter selects the source allowed to set the system time.
The default value enables all sources.

SYS_USE_IO.longDesc: Can be used to use a standard startup script but with a FMU only set-up. Set to 0 to force the FMU only set-up.

SYS_VEHICLE_RESP.longDesc:
Changes the overall responsiveness of the vehicle.
The higher the value, the faster the vehicle will react.
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
the acceleration or jerk limits).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

THR_MDL_FAC.shortDesc: Thrust to motor control signal model parameter
THR_MDL_FAC.longDesc:
Parameter used to model the nonlinear relationship between
motor control signal (e.g. PWM) and static thrust.
The model is: rel_thrust = factor * rel_signal^2 + (1-factor) * rel_signal,
where rel_thrust is the normalized thrust between 0 and 1, and
rel_signal is the relative motor control signal between 0 and 1.

TRIG_ACT_TIME.longDesc: This parameter sets the time the trigger needs to pulled high or low.

TRIG_DISTANCE.longDesc: Sets the distance at which to trigger the camera.

TRIG_INTERVAL.longDesc: This parameter sets the time between two consecutive trigger events

TRIG_MIN_INTERVA.longDesc:
This parameter sets the minimum time between two consecutive trigger events
the specific camera setup is supporting.

TRIG_PINS.longDesc: Selects which FMU pin is used (range: AUX1-AUX8 on Pixhawk controllers with an I/O board, MAIN1-MAIN8 on controllers without an I/O board. The PWM interface takes two pins per camera, while relay triggers on every pin individually. Example: Value 56 would trigger on pins 5 and 6. For GPIO mode Pin 6 will be triggered followed by 5. With a value of 65 pin 5 will be triggered followed by 6. Pins may be non contiguous. I.E. 16 or 61. In GPIO mode the delay pin to pin is < .2 uS. Note: only with a value of 56 or 78 it is possible to use the lower pins for actuator outputs (e.g. ESC's).

TRIG_PINS_EX.longDesc: This Bit mask selects which FMU pin is used (range: AUX9-AUX32) If the value is not 0 it takes precedence over TRIG_PINS. If bits above 8 are set that value is used as the selector for trigger pins. greater then 8. 0x00000300 Would be Pins 9,10. If the value is

TRIG_POLARITY.longDesc: This parameter sets the polarity of the trigger (0 = active low, 1 = active high )

TRIG_PWM_NEUTRAL.shortDesc: PWM neutral output on trigger pin

UAVCAN_LGT_NAV.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the RIGHT_OF_WAY lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_STROB.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the STROBE lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

must have a unique session key.

UXRCE_DDS_NS_IDX.longDesc:
Defines an index-based namespace for DDS messages, e.g, uav_0, uav_1, up to uav_9999
A value less than zero leaves the namespace empty

UXRCE_DDS_PRT.longDesc:
If ethernet is enabled and is the selected configuration for uXRCE-DDS,
the selected UDP port will be set and used.

UXRCE_DDS_PTCFG.longDesc:
Set the participant configuration on the Agent's system.
0: Use the default configuration.
1: Restrict messages to localhost
(use in combination with ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1).
2: Use a custom participant with the profile name "px4_participant".

UXRCE_DDS_RX_TO.longDesc:
Specifies after how many seconds without receiving data the DDS connection is reestablished.
A value less than one disables the RX rate timeout.

UXRCE_DDS_SYNCC.longDesc: When enabled along with UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT, uxrce_dds_client will set the system clock using the agents UTC timestamp.

UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT.longDesc: When enabled, uxrce_dds_client will synchronize the timestamps of the incoming and outgoing messages measuring the offset between the Agent OS time and the PX4 time.

UXRCE_DDS_TX_TO.longDesc:
Specifies after how many seconds without sending data the DDS connection is reestablished.
A value less than one disables the TX rate timeout.

VTE_ACC_D_UNC.shortDesc: UAV acceleration white-noise power spectral density
VTE_ACC_D_UNC.longDesc:
UAV velocity variance growth rate from acceleration noise (m^2/s^3), independent of update rate.
Higher values follow measurements faster and reject fewer outliers.

VTE_ACC_T_UNC.longDesc:
Target acceleration variance growth rate (m^2/s^5), independent of update rate. Moving-target builds only.
Higher values track manoeuvres faster and reject fewer outliers.

VTE_ACC_UNC_IN.longDesc:
Initial absolute target-acceleration variance per axis (moving-target builds only).
Changes apply at initialization/reset. Use VTE_ACC_T_UNC for ongoing manoeuvre tracking.

VTE_AID_MASK.shortDesc: Integer bitmask controlling data fusion and aiding methods
VTE_AID_MASK.longDesc:
Absolute target references (bits 0, 3, 5) require vehicle GNSS; their offset from vision is estimated as a bias.
Bit 0 overrides bits 3 and 5, which are ignored in moving-target builds.
bitmask: Target GNSS position (receiver on the target)

VTE_BIAS_UNC.longDesc:
GNSS/vision position-bias variance growth rate (m^2/s), independent of update rate.
Higher values track reference drift faster; lower values keep the bias steadier.

VTE_BIA_AVG_THR.longDesc:
Maximum 3D difference between raw and filtered bias to finish averaging after GNSS-first startup.
Lower values require steadier samples. Requires 5 consecutive matches and at least 0.6 s, or VTE_BIA_AVG_TOUT.
Set to 0 to disable averaging.

VTE_BIA_AVG_TOUT.longDesc:
Maximum time to average the GNSS/vision bias when starting from GNSS position. Vision fusion waits meanwhile.
If GNSS expires, switch to vision with the filtered bias. Set to 0 to disable averaging.

VTE_BIA_UNC_IN.longDesc:
Initial GNSS/vision position-bias variance per axis. Higher values allow larger initial bias corrections.
Applied at initialization/reset and bias activation. Use VTE_BIAS_UNC for ongoing drift.

VTE_BTOUT.longDesc:
Reset after this long without accepted position or yaw updates, tracked separately.
Velocity updates do not prevent position resets.

VTE_EVA_NOISE.shortDesc: Minimum standard deviation for vision yaw observations
VTE_EVA_NOISE.longDesc:
Minimum vision yaw noise; used only when reported noise is lower. Default: about 4 deg.
Lower values increase trust in yaw measurements and can cause control oscillations.

VTE_EVP_NOISE.shortDesc: Minimum standard deviation for vision relative-position observations
VTE_EVP_NOISE.longDesc:
Minimum vision position noise; used only when reported noise is lower.
Increase to reduce trust in position measurements.

VTE_GPS_P_NOISE.shortDesc: Minimum standard deviation for GPS position observations
VTE_GPS_P_NOISE.longDesc:
Minimum GNSS position noise for target, mission or home aiding; used only when reported noise is lower.
Increase to reduce trust in position measurements.

VTE_GPS_V_NOISE.shortDesc: Minimum standard deviation for GPS velocity observations
VTE_GPS_V_NOISE.longDesc:
Minimum GNSS velocity noise; used only when reported noise is lower.
Increase to reduce trust in velocity measurements.

VTE_M_REC_TOUT.longDesc: Maximum raw measurement age allowed for fusion.

VTE_M_UPD_TOUT.longDesc: Maximum age of local position, velocity and antenna-offset corrections. GNSS-to-vision alignment may span the measurement recent timeout.

VTE_POS_EN.shortDesc: Vision Target Estimator module enable position estimation

VTE_POS_NIS_THRE.shortDesc: Normalized innovation squared threshold for the position estimator
VTE_POS_NIS_THRE.longDesc:
Per-axis outlier gate for position and velocity measurements. Lower values reject more samples.
For Gaussian innovations, 3.84 rejects about 5% of valid samples; 6.63 rejects 1%.

VTE_POS_UNC_IN.shortDesc: Initial target and drone relative position uncertainty
VTE_POS_UNC_IN.longDesc:
Minimum initial variance of the relative target position in x, y, and z direction.
The variance reported by the initializing observation is used if it is larger.
Applied at initialization/reset and GNSS/vision bias activation.

VTE_TASK_MASK.shortDesc: Integer bitmask controlling the tasks of the target estimator

VTE_TGT_TOUT.longDesc:
Maximum time without accepted position or yaw updates before that estimate becomes invalid.
Keep below VTE_BTOUT.

VTE_VEL_UNC_IN.shortDesc: Initial target and drone relative velocity uncertainty
VTE_VEL_UNC_IN.longDesc:
Initial velocity variance per axis, applied separately to the UAV and moving target.
Changes apply at initialization/reset.

VTE_YAW_ACC_UNC.shortDesc: Yaw acceleration white-noise power spectral density
VTE_YAW_ACC_UNC.longDesc:
Yaw-rate variance growth rate from acceleration noise (rad^2/s^3), independent of update rate.
Higher values track heading changes faster; lower values smooth yaw more.

VTE_YAW_EN.shortDesc: Vision Target Estimator module enable orientation estimation

VTE_YAW_NIS_THRE.shortDesc: Normalized innovation squared threshold for the orientation estimator
VTE_YAW_NIS_THRE.longDesc:
Yaw outlier gate. Lower values reject more samples.
For Gaussian innovations, 3.84 rejects about 5% of valid samples; 6.63 rejects 1%.

VTE_YAW_UNC_IN.longDesc:
Initial yaw variance (rad^2); also used for yaw-rate variance ((rad/s)^2).
Changes apply at initialization/reset.

VTO_LOITER_ALT.longDesc: Altitude relative to home at which vehicle will loiter after front transition.

VT_ARSP_BLEND.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can start blending both fw and mc controls. Set to 0 to disable.

VT_ARSP_TRANS.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can switch to fw mode

VT_BT_TILT_DUR.shortDesc: Duration motor tilt up in backtransition
VT_BT_TILT_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_FW to VT_TILT_MC.

VT_B_DEC_FF.shortDesc: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to pitch feedforward gain

VT_B_DEC_I.shortDesc: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to pitch I gain

VT_B_DEC_MSS.longDesc:
Used to calculate back transition distance in an auto mode.
For standard vtol and tiltrotors a controller is used to track this value during the transition.

VT_B_REV_DEL.shortDesc: Delay in seconds before applying back transition throttle
VT_B_REV_DEL.longDesc: Set this to a value greater than 0 to give the motor time to spin down. unit s

VT_B_REV_OUT.shortDesc: Output on airbrakes channel during back transition
VT_B_REV_OUT.longDesc: Used for airbrakes or with ESCs that have reverse thrust enabled on a seperate channel Airbrakes need to be enables for your selected model/mixer

VT_B_TRANS_DUR.shortDesc: Maximum duration of a back transition
VT_B_TRANS_DUR.longDesc: Transition is also declared over if the groundspeed drops below MPC_XY_CRUISE.

VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.shortDesc: Back transition MC motor ramp up time
VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.longDesc: This sets the duration during which the MC motors ramp up to the commanded thrust during the back transition stage.

VT_B_TRANS_THR.shortDesc: Target throttle value for the transition to hover flight
VT_B_TRANS_THR.longDesc: standard vtol: pusher tailsitter, tiltrotor: main throttle Note for standard vtol: For ESCs and mixers that support reverse thrust on low PWM values set this to a negative value to apply active breaking For ESCs that support thrust reversal with a control channel please set VT_B_REV_OUT and set this to a positive value to apply active breaking

VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum allowed angle the vehicle is allowed to pitch down to generate forward force
VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX.longDesc: When fixed-wing forward actuation is active (see VT_FW_TRHUST_EN). If demanded down pitch exceeds this limmit, the fixed-wing forward actuators are used instead.

VT_ELEV_MC_LOCK.longDesc: If set to 1 the control surfaces are locked at the disarmed value in multicopter mode.

VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.shortDesc: Use fixed-wing actuation in hover to accelerate forward
VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.longDesc:
Prevents downforce from pitching the body down when facing wind.
Uses puller/pusher (standard VTOL), or forward-tilt (tiltrotor VTOL) to accelerate forward instead.
Only active if demanded pitch  is below VT_PITCH_MIN.
Use VT_FWD_THRUST_SC to tune it.
Descend mode is treated as Landing too.
Only active (if enabled) in height-rate controlled modes.

VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.shortDesc: Fixed-wing actuation thrust scale in hover
VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.longDesc:
Scale applied to the demanded pitch (below VT_PITCH_MIN) to get the fixed-wing forward actuation in hover mode.
Enabled via VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.

VT_FW_ALT_ERR.longDesc: Maximum negative altitude error for fixed wing flight. If the altitude drops below this value below the altitude setpoint the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and enter failsafe RTL.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.longDesc:
Enable differential thrust seperately for roll, pitch, yaw in forward (fixed-wing) mode.
The effectiveness of differential thrust around the corresponding axis can be
tuned by setting VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_SC.longDesc: This factor specifies how the yaw input gets mapped to differential thrust in forwards flight.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P.shortDesc: Pitch differential thrust factor in forward flight
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R.shortDesc: Roll differential thrust factor in forward flight
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.shortDesc: Yaw differential thrust factor in forward flight
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_MIN_ALT.longDesc:
Minimum altitude for fixed-wing flight. When the vehicle is in fixed-wing mode
and the altitude drops below this altitude (relative altitude above local origin),
it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

VT_FW_MOT_OFFID.shortDesc: The channel number of motors that must be turned off in fixed wing mode

VT_FW_PERM_STAB.longDesc: If set to one this parameter will cause permanent attitude stabilization in fw mode. This parameter has been introduced for pure convenience sake.

VT_FW_QC_HMAX.longDesc:
Maximum height above the ground (if available, otherwise above
Home if available, otherwise above the local origin) where triggering a quad-chute is possible.
At high altitudes there is a big risk to deplete the battery and therefore crash if quad-chuting there.

VT_FW_QC_P.longDesc:
Absolute pitch threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_FW_QC_R.longDesc:
Absolute roll threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_F_TRANS_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds used for a transition

VT_F_TRANS_THR.shortDesc: Target throttle value for the transition to fixed-wing flight

VT_F_TR_OL_TM.longDesc:
The duration of the front transition when there is no airspeed feedback available.
When airspeed is used, transition timeout is declared if airspeed does not
reach VT_ARSP_BLEND after this time.

VT_IDLE_PWM_MC.shortDesc: Idle speed of VTOL when in multicopter mode

VT_LND_PITCH_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum pitch angle during hover landing
VT_LND_PITCH_MIN.longDesc:
Overrides VT_PITCH_MIN when the vehicle is in LAND mode (hovering).
During landing it can be beneficial to reduce the pitch angle to reduce the generated lift in head wind.

VT_MC_ON_FMU.shortDesc: Enable the usage of AUX outputs for hover motors
VT_MC_ON_FMU.longDesc: Set this parameter to true if the vehicle's hover motors are connected to the FMU (AUX) port. Not required for boards that only have a FMU, and no IO. Only applies for standard VTOL and tiltrotor.

VT_MOT_ID.shortDesc: The channel number of motors which provide lift during hover

VT_PITCH_MIN.longDesc:
Any pitch setpoint below this value is translated to a forward force by the fixed-wing forward actuation if
VT_FWD_TRHUST_EN is set.

VT_PSHER_RMP_DT.longDesc: Defines the time window during which the pusher throttle will be ramped up linearly to VT_F_TRANS_THR during a transition to fixed wing mode. Zero or negative values will produce an instant throttle rise to VT_F_TRANS_THR.

VT_PSHER_SLEW.shortDesc: Pusher throttle ramp up slew rate
VT_PSHER_SLEW.longDesc:
Defines the slew rate of the puller/pusher throttle during transitions.
Zero will deactivate the slew rate limiting and thus produce an instant throttle
rise to the transition throttle VT_F_TRANS_THR.

VT_QC_ALT_LOSS.longDesc:
Altitude error threshold for quad-chute triggering during fixed-wing flight.
The check is only active if altitude is controlled and the vehicle is below the current altitude reference.
The altitude error is relative to the highest altitude the vehicle has achieved since it has flown below the current
altitude reference.
Set to 0 do disable.

VT_QC_T_ALT_LOSS.longDesc:
Altitude loss threshold for quad-chute triggering during VTOL transition to fixed-wing flight
in altitude-controlled flight modes.
Active until 5s after completing transition to fixed-wing.
If the current altitude is more than this value below the altitude at the beginning of the
transition, it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_TILT_SPINUP.shortDesc: Tilt actuator control value commanded when disarmed and during the first second after arming
VT_TILT_SPINUP.longDesc: This specific tilt during spin-up is necessary for some systems whose motors otherwise don't spin-up freely.

VT_TILT_TRANS.shortDesc: Normalized tilt in transition to FW

VT_TRANS_MIN_TM.longDesc: Minimum time in seconds for front transition.

VT_TRANS_P2_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_TRANS to VT_TILT_FW.

VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT.longDesc: Time in seconds after which transition will be cancelled.

WEIGHT_BASE.longDesc:
This is the weight of the vehicle at which it's performance limits were derived. A zero or negative value
disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.

WEIGHT_FUEL.shortDesc: Mass of a full fuel load
WEIGHT_FUEL.longDesc:
If set together with WEIGHT_BASE and WEIGHT_GROSS, the weight used for
performance scaling is reduced by the burned fuel reported in the fuel tank status.
Only a single fuel tank is supported. A zero or negative value disables fuel-based weight compensation.

WEIGHT_GROSS.longDesc:
This is the actual weight of the vehicle at any time. This value will differ from WEIGHT_BASE in case weight was added
or removed from the base weight. Examples are the addition of payloads or larger batteries. A zero or negative value
disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.

WV_GAIN.longDesc: The desired gain to convert roll sp into yaw rate sp.

WV_ROLL_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum roll angle setpoint for weathervane controller to demand a yaw-rate

WV_YRATE_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum yawrate the weathervane controller is allowed to demand

ZENOH_ENABLE.longDesc:
Set true (1) to start the Zenoh driver module (a.k.a the "Zenoh-Pico Node").
See https://docs.px4.io/main/en/middleware/zenoh and
https://docs.px4.io/main/en/modules/modules_driver.html#zenoh

ctl_bw.longDesc: Speed controller bandwidth, in Hz. Higher values result in faster speed and current rise times, but may result in overshoot and higher current consumption. For fixed-wing aircraft, this value should be less than 50 Hz; for multirotors, values up to 100 Hz may provide improvements in responsiveness.

ctl_dir.longDesc: Motor spin direction as detected during initial enumeration. Use 0 or 1 to reverse direction.

ctl_gain.longDesc:
Speed (RPM) controller gain. Determines controller
            aggressiveness; units are amp-seconds per radian. Systems with
            higher rotational inertia (large props) will need gain increased;
            systems with low rotational inertia (small props) may need gain
            decreased. Higher values result in faster response, but may result
            in oscillation and excessive overshoot. Lower values result in a
            slower, smoother response.

esc_index.shortDesc: Index of this ESC in throttle command messages.

gnss.dyn_model.longDesc:
Dynamic model used in the GNSS positioning engine. 0 –
        Automotive, 1 – Sea, 2 – Airborne.

gnss.old_fix_msg.longDesc:
Broadcast the old (deprecated) GNSS fix message
        uavcan.equipment.gnss.Fix alongside the new alternative
        uavcan.equipment.gnss.Fix2. It is recommended to
        disable this feature to reduce the CAN bus traffic.

gnss.warn_dimens.longDesc:
Set the device health to Warning if the dimensionality of
              the GNSS solution is less than this value. 3 for the full (3D)
              solution, 2 for planar (2D) solution, 1 for time-only solution,
              0 disables the feature.

gnss.warn_sats.longDesc:
Set the device health to Warning if the number of satellites
        used in the GNSS solution is below this threshold. Zero
        disables the feature

mot_i_max.longDesc:
Motor current limit in amps. This determines the maximum
            current controller setpoint, as well as the maximum allowable
            current setpoint slew rate. This value should generally be set to
            the continuous current rating listed in the motor’s specification
            sheet, or set equal to the motor’s specified continuous power
            divided by the motor voltage limit.

mot_kv.shortDesc: Motor Kv in RPM per volt
mot_kv.longDesc:
Motor Kv in RPM per volt. This can be taken from the motor’s
            specification sheet; accuracy will help control performance but
            some deviation from the specified value is acceptable.

mot_ls.shortDesc: READ ONLY: Motor inductance in henries.
mot_ls.longDesc: READ ONLY: Motor inductance in henries. This is measured on start-up.

mot_num_poles.longDesc:
Number of motor poles. Used to convert mechanical speeds to
            electrical speeds. This number should be taken from the motor’s
            specification sheet.

mot_rs.shortDesc: READ ONLY: Motor resistance in ohms
mot_rs.longDesc:
READ ONLY: Motor resistance in ohms. This is measured on start-up. When
            tuning a new motor, check that this value is approximately equal
            to the value shown in the motor’s specification sheet.

mot_v_max.longDesc:
Motor voltage limit in volts. The current controller’s
            commanded voltage will never exceed this value. Note that this may
            safely be above the nominal voltage of the motor; to determine the
            actual motor voltage limit, divide the motor’s rated power by the
            motor current limit.

uavcan.pubp-pres.longDesc:
Set the device health to Warning if the number of satellites
        used in the GNSS solution is below this threshold. Zero
        disables the feature
